zh_surface: 某人做好早餐后去洗手，回来却发现早餐消失了。为什么？
zh_truth: 家里的狗趁他没注意偷吃了早餐。
o_surface: 某人做好早餐後去洗手，回來卻發現早餐消失了。為什麼？
o_truth: 家裡的狗趁他沒注意偷吃了早餐。

zh_surface: 某人早上起来发现餐桌上有一滩水渍，但家里没人使用过餐桌。为什么？
zh_truth: 水壶漏水导致水滴到了餐桌上。
o_surface: 某人早上起來發現餐桌上有一灘水漬，但家裡沒人使用過餐桌。為什麼？
o_truth: 水壺漏水導致水滴到了餐桌上。

zh_surface: 某人注意到地板上出现了一道细长的刮痕，但他并未拖动过任何家具。为什么？
zh_truth: 宠物的指甲不小心刮到了地板。
o_surface: 某人注意到地板上出現了一道細長的刮痕，但他並未拖動過任何家具。為什麼？
o_truth: 寵物的指甲不小心刮到了地板。

zh_surface: 某人发现墙上的裂缝每天都在变大，但家里并没有地震或外力影响。为什么？
zh_truth: 墙体结构老化，裂缝自然扩大。
o_surface: 某人發現牆上的裂縫每天都在變大，但家裡並沒有地震或外力影響。為什麼？
o_truth: 牆體結構老化，裂縫自然擴大。

zh_surface: 某人晚上发现墙上的影子并不是自己的形状。为什么？
zh_truth: 光源照射家具产生的扭曲影子。
o_surface: 某人晚上發現牆上的影子並不是自己的形狀。為什麼？
o_truth: 光源照射家具產生的扭曲影子。

zh_surface: 某人早上起床发现阳台上的花盆倒了。为什么？
zh_truth: 昨晚的风太大，把花盆吹倒了。
o_surface: 某人早上起床發現陽台上的花盆倒了。為什麼？
o_truth: 昨晚的風太大，把花盆吹倒了。

zh_surface: 某人发现自己的笔记本被画满了涂鸦。为什么？
zh_truth: 是朋友的小孩偷偷拿去画画了。
o_surface: 某人發現自己的筆記本被畫滿了塗鴉。為什麼？
o_truth: 是朋友的小孩偷偷拿去畫畫了。

zh_surface: 某人在风平浪静的夜晚听到阳台风铃响动。为什么？
zh_truth: 一只小鸟不小心碰到了风铃。
o_surface: 某人在風平浪靜的夜晚聽到陽台風鈴響動。為什麼？
o_truth: 一隻小鳥不小心碰到了風鈴。

zh_surface: 某人早上发现花瓶的位置被移动了，但没人碰过它。为什么？
zh_truth: 昨晚地震导致花瓶稍微移动。
o_surface: 某人早上發現花瓶的位置被移動了，但沒人碰過它。為什麼？
o_truth: 昨晚地震導致花瓶稍微移動。

zh_surface: 某人回家发现门从里面反锁了，但屋里应该没人。为什么？
zh_truth: 是门的自动反锁机制启动了。
o_surface: 某人回家發現門從裡面反鎖了，但屋裡應該沒人。為什麼？
o_truth: 是門的自動反鎖機制啟動了。

zh_surface: 某人坐在椅子上时，椅子突然动了一下。为什么？
zh_truth: 是地板不平，椅子滑了一下。
o_surface: 某人坐在椅子上時，椅子突然動了一下。為什麼？
o_truth: 是地板不平，椅子滑了一下。

zh_surface: 某人收到一个包裹，却发现收件地址不是自己的。为什么？
zh_truth: 快递员不小心送错了门牌号。
o_surface: 某人收到一個包裹，卻發現收件地址不是自己的。為什麼？
o_truth: 快遞員不小心送錯了門牌號。

zh_surface: 某人晚上发现大门没有完全关上，但他明确记得锁好了门。为什么？
zh_truth: 风把门稍微推开了一条缝。
o_surface: 某人晚上發現大門沒有完全關上，但他明確記得鎖好了門。為什麼？
o_truth: 風把門稍微推開了一條縫。

zh_surface: 某人翻看通讯录时发现一个电话号码不见了。为什么？
zh_truth: 他误删了该联络人的号码。
o_surface: 某人翻看通訊錄時發現一個電話號碼不見了。為什麼？
o_truth: 他誤刪了該聯絡人的號碼。

zh_surface: 某人打开水龙头，却发现没有水流出来。为什么？
zh_truth: 水管冻住了，水无法流动。
o_surface: 某人打開水龍頭，卻發現沒有水流出來。為什麼？
o_truth: 水管凍住了，水無法流動。

zh_surface: 奥斯卡正坐在那儿看报纸，忽然听到一声响。当他明白发生了什么事时，他痛悔自己没能及时接住那辆“出租车”。不久之后，他自杀了。
zh_truth: 奥斯卡身无分文。他是一名微缩汽车模型收藏者，为了解决经济问题，他打算卖掉自己最值钱的那辆车。他一直在擦拭它，擦完后没有把它好好放回桌上。当他坐下开始看报纸时，他听到它从桌上掉了下来，却没能在它摔到地板之前及时接住它。
o_surface: Oscar was sitting reading his newspaper, when he heard a noise. When he realized what had happened, he bitterly regretted not having caught the taxi in time. Shortly afterwards, he committed suicide.
o_truth: Oscar was broke. He was a miniature car models collector and, to solve his economic problems, he was going to sell his most valuable car. He had been cleaning it and did not put it down on the table properly when he finished. When he sat down and began to read his newspaper, he heard how it fell off the table. He could not catch it in time before it crashed into the floor.

zh_surface: 那天早上马丁醒来时，惊讶地发现门开着。他刚一跨过门槛，脑袋就被咬掉了。
zh_truth: 马丁是一只金丝雀，已经在笼子里住了四个月。西尔维斯特——一只猫——一直在等机会抓住马丁并吃掉他。主人不小心没关好笼门，马丁飞了出来，西尔维斯特一口咬掉了他小小的脑袋。
o_surface: When Martin woke up that morning, he was surprised to see the door open. As soon as he crossed the threshold he got beheaded.
o_truth: Martin was a canary that had been living in his cage for four months. Silvester - a cat - was waiting for his opportumity to catch Martin and eat him. When their owner left the cage door open by mistake Martin flew out of it and Silvester bit off his small head.

zh_surface: 一名汽车司机在一个十字路口突然拐弯，撞上一辆自行车，引发了一场事故。警察赶到后，另一名男子却被逮捕了。真正开车的那个人则被送回了家。
zh_truth: 那名司机正在上驾驶课，教练让他在十字路口做了错误的转弯，撞上了自行车。警察认为驾驶教练应当为这起事故负责，于是逮捕了他，并把学员送回了家。
o_surface: A car driver causes an accident when he crashes into a bike, as he was making an unexpected turn at a crossroad. When the policemen arrive, another man gets arrested. The one who was driving is carried home.
o_truth: The driver was receiving driving lessons and his instructor told him to make an incorrect turn at a crossroad, crashing into a bike. The policemen considered the driving instructor to be responsible for the accident so they arrested him and took the learner home.

zh_surface: 一个女人——正在上班——正下楼时，突然停电了。就在那一刻，她意识到自己的丈夫快要死了。
zh_truth: 这个女人在一家医院当电工，她知道医院的应急发电机已经坏了。她的丈夫出了车祸，就住在那家医院，靠一台维持生命的机器呼吸。停电发生时，她明白丈夫无法自主呼吸，因此正在死去。
o_surface: A woman - at work - is going downstairs, when suddenly there is a blackout. In that very moment she realizes that her husband is about to die.
o_truth: The woman worked as an electrician at a hospital and she knew that the emergency generators were broken. He husband had had a car crash and he was at that hospital, connected to a machine that kept him alive. When the blackout happened she knew that her husband couldn't be breathing by himself and therefore that he was dying.

zh_surface: 一个女人在家里，很伤心，透过窗户望着街道。不久之后她从窗户跳了下去。就在那一瞬间，她听到电话响了，后悔自己跳了下来。
zh_truth: 一场核灾难之后，这个女人以为自己是唯一的幸存者，决定结束自己的生命。当电话响起时，她意识到自己并不孤单。但对她来说，已经太晚了。
o_surface: A woman is at home, sad, and watching the street through her window. Soon after she jumps out of it. Just in that precise moment, she hears the telephone ringing and regrets jumping.
o_truth: After a nuclear catastrophe, the woman thought that she was the only person alive and decided to put an end to her life. When the telephone rang she realized that she was not alone. But it was too late for her.

zh_surface: 一个商人目击了一起绑架案。然而，当他告诉警察时，警察却不相信他。
zh_truth: 从牙医诊所出来后，这位目击者的嘴还麻着，说不出清楚的话。警察以为他喝醉了，他说的一个字也不信。
o_surface: A businessman witnesses a kidnapping. However, when he tells the police, they do not believe him.
o_truth: After leaving the dentist, the witness was unable to speak properly, since he had numb mouth. The policemen thought that the man was drunk and did not believe a word he said.

zh_surface: 一个男的走进一家药店，不久后就带着收银机里的钱离开了。药店老板打电话给警察局，过了一段时间，一名警察追回了那笔钱，把那个男的带走了。当天晚上，这三个人一起去警察局报案，说家里被偷了。
zh_truth: 那个男的是药店老板的儿子。他的车被偷了，而他有一场重要的考试。他去药店是想找妈妈要点钱打车。除此之外，妈妈还打电话给她的丈夫——他是一名警察——让他把儿子送去考试。他照做了，而儿子既然不再需要那笔钱，就把钱还给了父亲，父亲又还给了母亲。一天结束时，全家人一起去报了汽车失窃案。
o_surface: A guy goes into a drugstore and leaves shortly after with the money from the cash register. The drugstore owner calls the Police Station and, some time later, a police officer recovers the money and takes the guy away. That evening the three people go to the police station to report a theft.
o_truth: The guy was the drugstore owner's son. His car had been stolen and he had an important exam. He had been to the drugstore to ask his mother for some money so he could take a taxi. In addition to this, the mother called her husband - who was a police officer - and asked him to bring their son to the exam. He did, and since the son did not need the money any more, he gave it back to his father, who returned it to the mother. At the end of the day, the whole family reported the car theft.

zh_surface: 两个男人正在互相殴打，然后两个人突然都倒在了地板上。
zh_truth: 其中一名拳击手的女儿被绑架了，如果她父亲赢了这场比赛，她就会被杀掉。比赛结束时，这名拳击手的对手晕倒了，而拳击手本人——为了不赢下这场比赛——自己扑倒在了地板上。
o_surface: Two men are beating each other up and both of them suddenly fall to the floor.
o_truth: The daughter of one of the boxers had been kidnapped and she would be killed if her father won the fight. At the end of the fight, the boxer's opponent fainted and the other boxer - in order not to win the match - threw himself to the floor.

zh_surface: 一对夫妇在海滩上发现了一具男人的尸体。尸体在一把遮阳伞下，背上插着一把刀。现场没有任何暴力痕迹，也没有血迹。尸检显示，这个人是自然死亡的。
zh_truth: 这个男人背上有一个刀的纹身，他死于心脏病发作。
o_surface: A couple find a man's corpse on the beach. The corpse is under an umbrella and has a knife on his back. There are no signs of violence and no traces of blood. The autopsy reveals that the man died of natural causes.
o_truth: The man, who had a tattoo of a knife on his back, died of a heart attack.

zh_surface: 一个女人正在看电影。突然，她听到外面传来许多爆炸声和人们的尖叫。随后是一片寂静。女人关掉电视，去睡觉了。
zh_truth: 那天是新年前夜。女人一直等到所有人都庆祝完，然后才上床睡觉。
o_surface: A woman is watching a movie. Suddenly she hears a lot of explosions and people screaming outside. Then there is silence. The woman turns off the TV and goes to sleep.
o_truth: It was New Year's Eve. The woman waited until everyone had finished celebrating and then went to bed.

zh_surface: 迈克尔在监狱里。有一天，他吃了午饭，去监狱的院子待了一会儿，最后又去了图书馆。傍晚时分，在监控摄像头拍不到的地方，他换了衣服。然后他从大门走了出去，离开了监狱，没有被抓到。
zh_truth: 迈克尔是这座监狱里的狱警。
o_surface: Michael is in prison. One day, he has luch, goes to prison courtyard for a while and finally visits the library. At dusk, out of the reach of the security cameras, he changes his clothes. He then goes through the door to leave the prison, without being caught.
o_truth: Michael worked as a guard in the prison.

zh_surface: 保罗回到家，很疲惫。他走进自己的房间，关灯睡觉。过了一会儿，他感到不安，打开灯环顾四周。他又把灯关掉，试着再次入睡。这样重复了好几次之后，他往床底下看了一眼，发现了一具尸体。
zh_truth: 一个小偷正在保罗家偷东西。保罗到家时，小偷躲到了床底下。紧张感太强烈了，小偷突发心脏病。保罗睡不着，是因为小偷手腕上手表的滴答声。
o_surface: Paul comes home tired. He goes to his room and turns off the light to sleep. After a while, feeling uneasy, he turns on the light and looks around. He turns the light back off and tries to sleep again. After repeating this several times, he takes a look under his bed and finds a dead body.
o_truth: A thief was stealing from Paul's home. When Paul arrived home, the thief hid under the bed. The tension became too much and the thief suffered a sudden heart attack Paul was unable to sleep due to the ticking of the thief's wristwatch.

zh_surface: 一个男人去看医生，取之前的检查结果。结果显示他没有任何健康问题。然而，他在看完诊不久后就自杀了。
zh_truth: 这个病人知道妻子对他不忠，但他只知道那个情人的名字。他的妻子向他发誓说这个情人根本不存在。可是，当这个男人离开医生办公室时，他在报告上看到了那个情人的名字。他意识到妻子是和医生出轨，无法承受这件事。
o_surface: A man goes to the doctor to get the results of some previous tests. The results do not show up any health issues. However, he commits suicide shortly after the visit.
o_truth: The patient knew that his wife was cheating on him, but he only knew the lover's name. His wife swore to him that this lover did not exist. However when the man left the doctor's, he saw the lover's name on the report. He realized his wife was cheating on him with the doctor and could not cope with it.

zh_surface: 蒂姆正在驾驶帆船航行，这时他的手表掉进了水里。他是个很棒的潜水员。然而，他还是没能把手表捞回来。
zh_truth: 蒂姆是在死海上航行。由于盐度非常高，他无法潜得足够深，把手表找回来。
o_surface: Tim is sailing his boat when his watch falls overboard. He is a great diver. However, he does not manage to retrieve the watch.
o_truth: Tim was sailing on the Dead Sea. Due to the high salt concentration, he couldn't dive deep enough to get his watch back.

zh_surface: 一个男人走进一家餐馆，点了一份信天翁，吃了一口，然后自杀了。为什么？
zh_truth: 这个男人曾在一艘失事后困在荒岛上的船上。当食物吃光以后，另一位乘客带来了他声称是信天翁的肉，其实那是这个男人的妻子的一部分（她在船难中死去了）。男人觉得其中有些蹊跷，所以当他们终于回到文明世界后，他点了一份信天翁，意识到自己之前吃的是妻子，便自杀了。（这个谜题还有一个用鲍鱼代替信天翁的版本）
o_surface: A man goes into a restaurant, orders albatross, eats one bite, and kills himself. Why?
o_truth:
The man was in a ship that was wrecked on a desert island. When there was no food left, another passenger brought what he said was albatross but was really part of the man's wife (who had died in the wreck). The man suspects something fishy, so when they finally return to civilization, he orders albatross , realizes that what he ate before was his wife, and kills himself. 

 (there is also a version of the riddle with an abalone instead of an albatross)

zh_surface: 尤金看着自己的亲友被杀死，却无法抹去脸上的笑容。
zh_truth: 尤金在马戏团里当小丑。有一次演出时，动物从围栏里逃了出来，所有人都撒腿就跑。人们和他的家人在踩踏中死去。但他无法抹去脸上的笑容，因为那是小丑的妆容。
o_surface:
Eugene was watching his relatives and friends being killed, but he couldn’t wipe the smile

off his face.
o_truth:
Eugene worked as a clown in a circus. Once, animals escaped from

their enclosures during a performance, and everyone broke into a run. People

and members of his family were dying in the stampede. But he couldn’t wipe the

smile off his face because of the clown makeup.

zh_surface: 托尼抱着两个袋子跑出大楼。另一个男人跟在他后面追，一边喊一边挥舞着刀。
zh_truth: 托尼在店里购物，花了很多钱，所以店员们决定送他一份礼物：一套厨房刀具。托尼赶时间，跑向自己的车，把这件事忘了。店员注意到了，就追上去想把礼物送给他。
o_surface: Tony ran out of the building, carrying two bags. Another man ran after him, shouting and waving knives.
o_truth: Tony was shopping in the store, he spent a lot of money, so the shop workers decided to give him a gift: a set of kitchen knives. Tony was in a hurry so he ran to his car, forgetting about it. The worker noticed this and ran after Tony to give him the gift.

zh_surface: 当神父停止讲话时，博比死了。
zh_truth: 博比是一只小仓鼠，跟着九岁的饲主汤姆一起来到教堂。当神父在信徒面前讲话时，小仓鼠从孩子的腿上溜走，跑到了祭坛上。神父讲完话朝自己的椅子走去时，没有看见博比，一脚把他踩死了。
o_surface: When the priest stopped talking, Bobby died.
o_truth: Bobby was a little hamster who had come to the church along with Tom, his 9-year-old owner. When the priest was speaking in front of the believers, the little hamster escaped from the child's lap and went to the altar. When the priest finished speaking and headed towards his chair, he did not see Bobby and crushed him with his foot.

zh_surface: 一个男人气喘吁吁地从一栋房子里出来，关上房门，快步走下楼梯。然后他走过两个街区，来到另一栋房子，走进去，松了一口气。
zh_truth: 这个男人刚刚搬家。他带着最后一批箱子到达新家，松了一口气，因为他终于搬完了。
o_surface: A man comes breathless out of a house, closes the door and goes quickly down stairs. Then he walks two blocks to get to another house, enters and breathes relieved.
o_truth: The man had just moved. He arrived to his new home with the last boxes and he breathed a sigh of relief because he had finished.

zh_surface: 这个男人准备开车去上班，却发现有一个轮胎没气了。他什么也没做，就坐进车里，开了二十公里到单位，然后又开回家，一点也不觉得尴尬。他是怎么做到的？
zh_truth: 瘪掉的是备胎，那个放在后备箱里的备胎。
o_surface: The man was going to go to work by car, but found that one of the tires was flat. Without doing anything, he got into the car and drove 20 kilometers to work and then back home, without the slightest embarrassment. How could he manage it?
o_truth: The tire was flat on the spare wheel, which was in the trunk.

zh_surface: 一个女人去度假，请一个朋友帮忙照看她的猫。一周后，有八只猫在公寓里跑来跑去！
zh_truth: 第二天，这只猫跑掉了，朋友只好开始找它。因为他对这只猫不太熟悉，只好把所有见过的、长得像的猫都留下，等那位本该来认出正确宠物的朋友来辨认。
o_surface: A woman went on vacation and asked a friend to look after her cat. A week later, 8 cats were running around the apartment!
o_truth: The next day this cat ran away, and the friend had to start looking for it. Since he did not know the cat very well, he had to keep all the similar cats that he had seen and wait for the friend who was supposed to identify the right pet.

zh_surface: 一个男人和一个女人结婚了。婚礼之后，他们放弃了所有为自己赚钱的事业，只顾玩乐。结果，三年后他们成了百万富翁。
zh_truth: 婚礼之前，他们是亿万富翁。因此在这三年里，他们花掉了大量的钱，结果变成了百万富翁。
o_surface: A man and a woman got married. After the wedding they abandoned all their activities, that were bringing them money, and only had fun. As a result, in three years they became millionaires.
o_truth: Before the wedding, they were billionaires. Therefore during these three years they spent a lot of money and as a result became millionaires.

zh_surface: 约翰走在白雪覆盖的田野上。当他走到一棵孤零零的树旁时，他看见树上挂着一个男人的尸体。他死于前一天晚上的绞杀，但除了约翰自己的痕迹，他周围没有任何其他痕迹。
zh_truth: 被吊着的男人是一名跳伞者。他的降落伞缠住了，挂在了树枝上。
o_surface: John was walking along the snow-covered field. When he came to a lonely tree, he saw the corpse of a man hanging on the tree. He died the last night from strangulation, but there were no traces around him, except John's ones.
o_truth: The hanged man was a skydiver. His parachute was entangled and caught on branches of the tree.

zh_surface: 这个男人正沿着铁轨走，突然看见一列火车朝他迎面驶来。于是他拼命地迎着开过来的火车跑。
zh_truth: 这个男人在一个隧道里，为了保住自己的命，他必须沿着铁轨迎着火车跑。当隧道到了尽头，他才能跳下铁轨。多亏这样，他活了下来。
o_surface: The man was walking along the rails and suddenly he saw a train coming towards him. Then he ran like hell to meet the approaching train.
o_truth: The man was in a tunnel and, in order to save his own life, he had to run along the rails to meet the train. When the tunnel was over, he was able to jump off the rails. And thanks to that, he remained alive.

zh_surface: 一个男人在跑，一群人跟在他后面跑。这个男人对着人群大喊：“你们永远也见不到黄金了！”然后他开始开枪。看到这一切的人们却欢呼起来。
zh_truth: 那是冬季两项比赛。
o_surface: A man is running, a crowd is running after him. The man is screaming to the crowd:"You will never see the gold!" and he starts shooting. People who observe all that are exulting.
o_truth: It was the biathlon.

zh_surface: 一个男人出差回来，按响一扇门的门铃，他的妻子来开门。他立刻指责她背叛了自己。
zh_truth: 在回家的路上，这个男人决定去拜访他的朋友。而那扇门是他自己的妻子开的——她当时衣冠不整。
o_surface: A man returns from a business trip, he rings a door, his wife opens it. He immediately accused her of betrayal.
o_truth: On the way back home, this man decided to visit his friend. And the door was opened by his own half-dressed wife.

zh_surface: 一个猎人仔细瞄准，扣动了扳机。几秒钟后，他意识到自己犯了个错误。几分钟后，他死了。
zh_truth: 他在白雪覆盖的群山中打猎。枪声引发了雪崩，把这个人埋了起来。他死于窒息。
o_surface: A hunter aimed his gun carefully and fired. Seconds later, he realized his mistake. Minutes later, he was dead.
o_truth: He hunted in snow-capped mountains. The shot provoked an avalanche, which covered the man. He died of strangulation.

zh_surface: 安德鲁决定和家人一起度过这个晚上。他给全家都买了票，但他自己的那张票却让他丢了性命。
zh_truth: 安德鲁带家人去了动物园。他觉得门票太贵了，于是决定不给自己买票。他翻过了围墙，却掉进了一个关着狮子的笼舍。等他明白发生了什么事时，已经太晚了。
o_surface: Andrew decided to spend the evening with his family. He bought tickets for the whole family, but his ticket cost him his life.
o_truth: Andrew took his family to the zoo. He found the tickets too expensive. So, he decided not to buy a ticket for himself. He climbed over the wall but got into a cage with a lion. When he realized what happened, it was too late.

zh_surface: 大洋中央有一艘游艇。附近的水里有好几具尸体漂浮着。
zh_truth:
一群人乘游艇出海航行。有一天，他们决定下水游泳——他们换上泳衣，从船舷跳了下去。他们后来才发现，自己忘了把梯子从船边放下去，无法再爬回船上，于是都淹死了。

另一种解答（二选一）：

同样的情形，但他们放下了一架刚好够长的梯子。当他们跳进水里后，失去了他们重量的船在水面上略微上浮，使梯子刚好变得够不着。
o_surface: In the middle of the ocean is a yacht. Several corpses are floating in the water nearby.
o_truth:
A group of people were on an ocean voyage in a yacht. One day, they decided to go swimming — they put on their swimsuits and dove off the side. They discovered belatedly that they have forgotten to put a ladder down the side of the yacht and were unable to climb back in, so they drowned. 

 Alternate Solution (choose one): 

 The same situation, but they set out a ladder that was just barely long enough. When they dove into the water, the boat, without their weight, rose slightly in the water, putting the ladder just out of reach.

zh_surface: 一个男人死在自己家里，死于口渴。这怎么会发生？
zh_truth: 这个男人的家是一艘游艇，他乘着它环游世界。在大洋上航行时，他的淡水比他预想的快得多就用完了。
o_surface: A man dies of thirst at home. How could it happen?
o_truth: The man’s home was a yacht, in which he was travelling around the world. While sailing in the ocean, he ran out of fresh water much faster than he expected.

zh_surface: 这个男人收到一个包裹，在里面发现了一只死老鼠。他报了警，而寄这个包裹的人被判犯有诈骗罪。
zh_truth: 寄件人本应把珠宝寄给这个男人。他希望老鼠会在盒子上咬出一个洞然后逃走，这样就没有人能责怪他弄丢了珠宝。
o_surface: The man received the parcel in which he found a dead mouse. He reported this to the police, and the sender of this parcel was found guilty of fraud.
o_truth: The sender was supposed to send the jewels to this man. He hoped that the mouse would gnaw a hole in the box and run away, and nobody could blame on him for the loss.

zh_surface:
一名警探循着罪犯的踪迹走进一家国际象棋俱乐部。他打量了一下局面，便对助手们说：“把那两个人扣起来！”

他是怎么猜出来的？
zh_truth: 那两个“下棋的人”当中，有一个人的棋盘上没有王。
o_surface:
Following criminals’ trail, a police inspector entered a chess club. Assessing the situation, he told his assistants, “Detain those two!” 

How did he guess?
o_truth: One of the “chess players” had no kings on the board.

zh_surface: 委内瑞拉警方曾几次尝试逮捕一名臭名昭著的匪徒。他们知道他的住处。有时他们拿到逮捕令，就开车来到他的房子前。可每次他们一进屋，他就锁上卧室的门。警察无可奈何，只能空手而归。
zh_truth: 他的房子正好坐落在委内瑞拉与哥伦比亚的边境线上。虽然前门和房子的一半在委内瑞拉境内，卧室却位于哥伦比亚境内。委内瑞拉警方在哥伦比亚没有管辖权，所以只要他在卧室里，警察就抓不了他。
o_surface: The Venezuelan police made a few attempts to arrest a well-known bandit. They knew where he lived. From time to time they got the arrest warrant and approached his house. When they entered the house, he locked in the bedroom. The police had nothing to do but to leave empty-handed.
o_truth: His house was on the border between Venezuela and Colombia. Although the front door and half of the house were on the territory of Venezuela, the bedroom was located on the territory of Colombia. The Venezuelan police had no jurisdiction in Colombia, so the police couldn't arrest him while he was in the bedroom.

zh_surface: 一个人打电话报警，让警方去打听约翰·K的情况。警察赶到约翰家时，发现他已经死了。检查尸体时，警察发现了严重的伤痕。可公寓里整整齐齐，没有任何搏斗或入室的痕迹。
zh_truth: 一名司机在夜里撞倒了一个路人，从对方身上的证件里找到了他的住址，发现他独自居住，便把他送回了家。
o_surface: A person called the police and told them to ask about John K. Upon arrival at John’s house, the police found him dead. Examining the corpse, the police discovered severe injuries. But the apartment was in perfect order, without any signs of a struggle or break-in.
o_truth: A driver hit a passerby at night, found his address in the documents, discovered that he lived alone, and took him home.

zh_surface: 一名男子被发现死在血水和积水里，躺在一间除此之外空无一物、没有窗户的密室地板上。这是怎么发生的？
zh_truth: 他用一根冰锥刺死了自己。
o_surface:
A man is found dead in a puddle of blood and water on the floor of an otherwise empty

locked room with no windows. How could this happen?
o_truth: He stabbed himself with an icicle.

zh_surface: 一名男子走到一株仙人掌前，看了看别在那里的一张纸，然后自杀了。
zh_truth: 这名男子在沙漠里迷了路，一直在四处徘徊。他担心自己其实一直在原地兜圈子。为了验证这一点，他把一张空白的纸别在仙人掌上，然后继续往前走。当他再次遇到那张纸时，他的担忧得到了证实——他知道自己永远也走不出去了。
o_title: Piece of Paper on the Cactus
o_surface: A man walks up to a cactus, looks at a piece of paper pinned there, and kills himself.
o_truth: The man has been wandering lost in the desert. He fears he has been walking in circles. To test this, he pins a blank piece of paper to a cactus and sets off walking. When he encounters the paper again, his fears are confirmed and he knows he will never find his way out.

zh_surface: 上床睡觉前，这个女人把一只鞋藏进了保险箱。这是为什么？
zh_truth: 这个女人是飞机上的空乘人员。在酒店里睡前，她会把证件放进保险箱；为了第二天早上不忘记拿证件，她就一只鞋和证件放在一起。
o_surface: Before going to bed, the woman hides her shoe in the safe. What for?
o_truth: This woman works as a stewardess on an airplane. In the hotel before going to bed she puts her documents in the safe, and to not forget them in the morning, she puts one of her shoes along with the documents.

zh_surface: 一个健康的年轻女孩，为什么要在没有受伤的手臂上打石膏？
zh_truth: 在一场法语口语考试之前，这个年轻女孩在健康的手臂上打了石膏。她认为考官会问起她的手臂，于是特意为这个问题做好准备，然后去参加考试。
o_surface: Why did a healthy young girl put a gypsum on her arm, which was not damaged?
o_truth: A young girl put a gypsum on the healthy arm before an oral french exam. She thought that the examiner would ask about her arm. And she came to the exam, having prepared for this particular question.

zh_surface: 这个女人正在说些什么，她很难过。没有人能听懂她，但有一个男人正用摄像机对着她拍摄。为什么？发生了什么事？
zh_truth:
这是真事。英国语言学家戴维·多尔比博士拍摄了一位八十七岁的非洲妇女，她的母语是比基亚语（比基亚语很可能正是因为这项工作而最为人所知）。

顺带一提，人们原本以为她是最后一位使用者，但基斯林在二〇〇七年报告说，在富鲁语系诸语言中，比基亚语是现存使用者最多的一种。
o_surface: The woman is speaking something and she is upset. Nobody can understand her but a man is filming her on camera. Why? And what is happening?
o_truth:
It happened for real. English linguist Dr. David Dalby filmed an 87-year-old African woman who spoke Bikya as her native tongue (and Bikya is probably best known for this particular work).

By the way, it was thought that she was the last speaker, but Kiessling (2007) reports that Bikya has the largest number of remaining speakers of the Furu languages.

zh_surface: 为什么亚历山大大帝命令他的军队把胡子剃掉？
zh_truth:
当统帅帕米尼奥问起原因时，据古代历史学家普鲁塔克记载，亚历山大回答说：“你难道不知道，在战斗中没有什么比胡子更好抓的东西吗？”

但有充分的理由怀疑普鲁塔克的解释。战场上揪胡子的故事是神话，而非史实。普鲁塔克和后世的史学家误解了这道命令，因为他们忽略了最相关的事实：亚历山大敢于做一件从来没有哪位自尊的希腊领袖做过的事——把自己的脸刮干净，把自己比作半神赫拉克勒斯，而赫拉克勒斯在绘画和雕塑中，总是以青春不老、无须的裸体形象出现。正如他在战前对将领们所说，亚历山大最希望的是每个人都能把自己看作这项使命中不可或缺的一部分。如果他们每个人看上去都更像自己那位英雄般的统帅，他们当然会更清楚地意识到这一点。
o_surface: Why Alexander the Great told his army to shave off their beards?
o_truth:
When the commander Parmenio asked the reason, according to the ancient historian Plutarch, Alexander replied, “Don’t you know that in battles there is nothing handier to grasp than a beard?” 

 ---

But there is ample cause to doubt Plutarch’s explanation. Stories of beard-pulling in battles were myth rather than history. Plutarch and later historians misunderstood the order because they neglected the most relevant fact, namely that Alexander had dared to do what no self-respecting Greek leader had ever done before: shave his face, likening himself to the demigod Heracles, rendered in painting and sculpture in the immortal splendor of youthful, beardless nudity. Alexander wished above all, as he told his generals before the battle, that each man would see himself as a crucial part of the mission. They would certainly see this more clearly if each of them looked more like their heroic commander.

zh_surface: 孩子们在看电视的时候，并没有那么害怕。但当他们看到别人在受苦时，他们才意识到出了什么问题。
zh_truth: 这是一项给孩子们抽血的实验。实验显示，在这个过程中，看电视的孩子感觉比有父母陪伴的孩子更好。
o_surface: When kids were watching TV, they were not frigthened so much. But when they saw others suffering, they realized that something was not right.
o_truth: It was an experiment when kids were giving blood. It showed that the kids were feeling better during this process if they were watching TV rather than if they were supported by their parents.

zh_surface: 一个男人设计了一种装置，把彩色纸放进去，就能得到完美的百元美钞。连专家都无法把它们和真钞区分开。他是怎么做到的？他又为什么要卖掉这台装置？
zh_truth: 这个男人把这台装置卖给一个小偷，让对方相信它能印出与真钞毫无差别的假美钞。演示的时候，他把一张绿纸放进机器。可那张“绿纸”其实是一张真正的百元美钞，只是被厚厚地涂成了绿色。机器要做的，不过是把上面的绿色涂料去掉而已。
o_surface: A man designed a device into which you can insert colored paper, and then get the ideal 100$. Experts can not distinguish them from the real ones. How does he do that, and why does he sell this device?
o_truth: The man sells this device to the thief, convincing him that it prints counterfeit dollars that are indistinguishable from the real ones. He demonstrates the machine by inserting green paper into it. But green paper - this is actually real 100$, but richly painted in green. The machine simply removes green paint from them.

zh_surface: 他因为弄混了颜色而死。
zh_truth: 在泰国，如果有人被蛇咬伤，医生必须辨明蛇的种类，才能选择正确的抗毒血清。游客通常认不出蛇的种类，所以医生会问他蛇是什么颜色，专家再根据这个信息判断蛇的种类。这名男子是色盲，因此接受了错误的抗毒血清。
o_surface: He died because he mixed up the colors.
o_truth: In Thailand if some snake bites you, doctor has to identify the snake's species in order to choose the right antidote. The tourist usually can not identify it, so doctor asks him/her what color the snake was, and using this information specialist defines snake's species. The man was colorblind, therefore he received a wrong antidote.

zh_surface: 迈克尔鼓了鼓掌，房间里的所有人（除了他自己）都死了。发生了什么事？
zh_truth: 迈克尔在打蚊子。
o_surface: Michael applaused, and everyone in the room (except him) died. What happened?
o_truth: Michael was killing mosquitoes.

zh_surface: 二十世纪五十年代的美国发明了一种“鸡炮”。它是用来做什么的？
zh_truth: 鸡炮是一门大口径的压缩空气炮，用来把死鸡射向飞机的零部件，以模拟飞机飞行时遭遇高速鸟撞的情形。喷气发动机和飞机挡风玻璃尤其容易被这类撞击损坏，也是这类测试中最常见的目标。人们认为，整只的、死的、标准大小的鸡（就像做菜用的那种）能够准确地模拟一只大型活鸟撞击飞行中的飞机。
o_surface: In the 1950s in America there was invented a chicken gun. What for?
o_truth: A chicken gun is a large-diameter, compressed-air cannon used to fire dead chickens at aircraft components in order to simulate high-speed bird strikes during the aircraft's flight. Jet engines and aircraft windshields are particularly vulnerable to damage from such strikes, and are the most common target in such tests. Whole, dead, standard-size chickens, as would be used for cooking, are thought to accurately simulate a large, live bird striking a plane in flight.

zh_surface: 怎样才能把一只长成的梨放进一瓶白兰地里？
zh_truth: 这也许比把一艘船放进瓶子里容易些，但同样需要耐心。梨并不是被放进去的，而是在瓶子里长成的。当果实还小的时候，人们把瓶子固定在树枝上，梨就在瓶子里一直长到成熟。
o_surface: How do you get a full-grown pear inside a bottle of brandy?
o_truth: It may be easier than putting a ship in a bottle but requires just as much patience. The pear isn’t put into the bottle; it grows inside it. When the fruit is small, the bottle is affixed to the tree branch, and the pear grows to maturity inside the bottle.

zh_surface: 来到一个风景秀丽的山村游玩的人，常常被村里的“傻子”逗乐。当让他在一枚闪亮的五十分硬币和一张皱巴巴的五美元纸币之间做选择时，他总是高高兴兴地挑那枚半美元硬币。那张纸币的价值是它的十倍，可他为什么从来都不选它呢？
zh_truth: 这个所谓的“傻子”其实聪明得很，他明白只要自己一直选五十分硬币，人们就会不断地给他这种选择的机会。一旦他拿了一次五美元纸币，这些送上门来的硬币就再也不会来了。
o_surface: Visitors to a scenic mountain village were often amused by the village idiot. When offered a choice between a shiny 50-cent piece and a crumpled $5 bill, he would always happily choose the half-dollar. The bill was worth ten times as much, so why did he never choose it?
o_truth: The so-called village idiot was smart enough to realize that as long as he kept choosing a 50-cent piece, people would keep offering him the choice. If he took the $5 bill once, the stream of coins would stop rolling in.

zh_surface:
一名男子被困在一座长满森林的岛上。一天，当风从西边吹来时，闪电击中了岛的最西端，点燃了森林。火势非常猛烈，烧毁了沿途的一切；如果不加干预，大火会烧遍整座岛，把他也烧死。岛的四周都是悬崖，他无法跳下去。

这个人怎样才能在大火中活下来？（没有任何水桶或别的灭火工具）
zh_truth: 这名男子拾起一块木头，从岛西端的火里把它点燃，然后迅速把它带到岛的最东端附近，放起一场新的火。风会让这场新火烧尽东端，之后他就可以躲进已经烧过的那片区域里。
o_surface:
A man is stranded on an island covered in forest. One day, when the wind is blowing from the west, lightning strikes the west end of the island and sets fire to the forest. The fire is very violent, burning everything in its path, and without intervention the fire will burn the whole island, killing the man in the process. There are cliffs around the island, so he cannot jump off.

How can the man survive the fire? (There are no buckets or any other means to put out the fire)
o_truth: The man picks up a piece of wood and lights it from the fire on the west end of the island. He then quickly carries it near the east end of he island and starts a new fire. The wind will cause that fire to burn out the eastern end and he can then shelter in the burnt area.

zh_surface: 一个富人的儿子被绑架了。绑匪要这个富人把一颗昂贵的钻石送到城市公园里的一个电话亭里放好。警察包围了这座公园，想抓住罪犯。被绑架孩子的父亲来到电话亭，完全照绑匪说的做了，可警察却没能阻止这个狡猾的罪犯把钻石从电话亭里取走。他们也没能抓住那个坏蛋。他到底做了什么？
zh_truth: 这是发生在台湾的一件真事。当父亲来到电话亭时，他发现笼子里有一只信鸽。鸽子身上系着一张字条，上面写着：把钻石放进系在鸽子脖子上的小袋子里，然后把鸽子从笼子里放出来。富人照做之后，鸽子飞越整座城市，回到自己的鸽舍，警察根本无法追踪它。
o_surface: The son of a rich man was kidnapped. The kidnapper wanted the rich man to bring and put the expensive diamond into the call-box located in a city park. Policemen surrounded this park, intending to catch the criminal. The father of the kidnapped child came to the call-box and did everything the kidnapper said to him, but the police could not prevent the cunning criminal from taking the diamond out of the call-box. They didn't grab the villian as well. What did he do?
o_truth: This is a real history that happened in Taiwan. When the father came to the call-box, he found a postal pigeon in the cage. There was a note attached to him, in which it was said that the diamond should be put into a small pouch attached to the neck of the pigeon, and then he should let the pigeon out of the cage. When the rich man did this, the dove flew through the city to its dovecote, and the police could not follow it.

zh_surface: 有两种装置被人们普遍使用。它们是为同一个目的而造出来的。但其中一种有很多零件，另一种却一个也没有。这两样东西是什么？
zh_truth:
其中一种是沙漏，另一种是日晷。

两种装置都是很久以前发明的。
o_surface: Two devices are commonly used by people. They are created for the same purpose. But one of them has lots of details and another does not has any. What are these things?
o_truth:
One of these devices is hourglass. Another one is sundial. 

 Little hint for players: both devices are invented long time ago.

zh_surface: 一个男人到某所学校考察，他注意到，每当老师提问时，都有很多学生准备好回答。而且，每次老师点的都是不同的人，答案却总是正确的。
zh_truth: 老师让学生们不管被问到什么问题都举手。但如果他们知道答案，就举右手；否则就举左手。这样，老师就能在知道答案的学生当中挑人回答。
o_surface: A man, who was examining some school, noticed that any time a teacher was asking a question, lots of pupils were ready to answer. Moreover, every time the teacher was choosing another person and the answer was always right.
o_truth: The teacher told pupils to raise up their hands no matter what question would be asked. But if they khew the answer, they should raise the right hand, otherwise - the left one. Therefore the teacher could choose among the pupils who knew the answer.

zh_surface: 一个人决定和尼克·法尔多打一场高尔夫球，他提出一个条件——比赛的时间和地点由他来定。尼克答应了。结果，这个人打败了这位冠军。
zh_truth: 这个人是盲人，他选择在一个没有月亮的夜晚比赛。他在黑暗中也能把高尔夫打得很好。（这是真的，盲人可以在视力正常者的帮助下打高尔夫。）这样的条件对尼克来说太不寻常，所以他输了。
o_surface: One person decided to play golf with Nick Faldo, imposing one condition - he will choose the time and the place for a match. Nick agreed. As a result this person beat the champion.
o_truth: This person was blind and he chose to play this match at moonless night. He could play golf perfectly well in dark. (It is true, blind people can play golf with the help of not blind people). Such conditions were unusual for Nick so he lost.

zh_surface: 在某座城市，车祸中受伤的人数非常多。于是市政当局决定强制使用安全带。人们开始遵守这项规定。但车祸的数量保持不变。而且，到医院就医的伤者人数甚至增加了。
zh_truth: 这条法律减少了车祸中的死亡人数。许多原本不系安全带会死的人活了下来，但受了伤，因此去了医院。所以病人的人数增加了。
o_surface: In some city an amount of people injured in car accidents was very high. Then it was decided by administration to make the using of seat belts oblidatory. People started to obey this rule. But the amount of crash accidents remained the same. Moreover, the number of injured people who addressed to the hospital even increased.
o_truth: The adopted law decreased the number of accidents. A lot of people who would die without seat belt stayed alive but got injured and therefore they went to the hospital. So the number of patients increased.

zh_surface: 一位医院院长最近证实，被送进他医院的很多人根本没有生病。他们完全健康，却得到了医院的护理和治疗。
zh_truth: 这家医院是一家妇产医院，所有入住者都是孕妇。
o_surface: A hospital director recently confirmed that many that many of people admitted to his hospital were not ill at all. They were perfectly healthy, yet were given hospital care and treatment.
o_truth: The hospital was a maternity hospital and all those admitted were pregnant women.

zh_surface: 格陵兰超过百分之八十的土地被冰雪覆盖。可它为什么被叫作格陵兰（绿色的土地）？
zh_truth: 格陵兰这个名字来自斯堪的纳维亚的定居者。在北欧萨迦中记载，“红发埃里克”因杀人被逐出冰岛。他乘船出发，去寻找传说中位于西北方的一片陆地。在那里定居之后，他把这片土地命名为格陵兰，以吸引更多的人前来定居。
o_surface: Over 80 percent of Greenland is covered in ice. But why then it was called Greenland (a green land)?
o_truth: The name Greenland comes from Scandinavian settlers. In the Norse sagas, it is said that Erik the Red was exiled from Iceland for murder. He set out in ships to find land rumoured to be to the northwest. After settling there, he named the land Grfnland (Greenland) to attract more people to settle there.

zh_surface: 一个小女孩被父母警告，绝对不要打开地窖的门。如果她打开，就会看到他们不想让她看到的东西。一天，父母外出时，不小心没把地窖的门锁上。女孩打开了地窖门。她看到了什么？
zh_truth: 女孩打开地窖门后，看到了客厅，还透过窗户看到了一座美丽的花园。她以前从未见过这些，因为父母一辈子都把她关在地窖里。
o_surface: A little girl was warned by her parents never to open the cellar door. If she did, she would see things that they did not want her to see. One day, while her parents were out, they accidentally left the cellar door unlocked. The girl opened the cellar door. What did she see?
o_truth: When the girl opened the cellar door she saw the living room and a beautiful garden through its windows. She had never seen these before because her parents had kept her in the cellar all her life.

zh_surface: 一个男人去参加聚会，喝了一些潘趣酒（一种用果汁调制的混合饮料），然后提前离开了。聚会上所有喝过潘趣酒的人后来都中毒身亡。为什么这个男人没有死？
zh_truth: 潘趣酒里的毒来自冰块。这个男人喝潘趣酒的时候，冰块还完全冻着。随着冰块渐渐融化，毒才被释放到酒里。
o_surface: A man went into a party and drank some of the punch. He then left early. Everyone at the party who drunk the punch subsequently died of poisoning. Why did the man not die?
o_truth: The poison from the punch came from the ice cubes. When the man drank the punch, the ice was fully frozen. Gradually, as the ice cubes melted the poison was released into the punch.

zh_surface: 一对夫妻开车飞快地驶向城里，途中他们的轿车没油了。男人确认妻子关好车窗、锁好车门之后，就去找人帮忙。等他回来时，发现妻子已经死了，车里还有一个陌生人。车窗仍然关着，车门仍然锁着，车子也没有任何损坏。
zh_truth: 那个女人生下了一个孩子，然后因失血过多而死。由于父亲从未见过这个婴儿，从严格意义上说，这个孩子可以称为陌生人。
o_surface: A married couple was speeding into town when their sedan ran out of gas. The man went for help after making sure his wife closed the windows and locked the doors of the car. Upon his return, he found his wife dead and a stranger in the car. The windows were still closed, the doors were still locked, and no damage was done to the car.
o_truth: The woman gave birth, and bled to death. Since the father has never seen the baby before, the kid can technically be called a stranger.

zh_surface: 十九世纪末，一位美国企业家发明了一套用来对抗竞争的系统。这套系统我们如今人人都在使用。
zh_truth:
这位美国企业家叫阿尔蒙·布朗·斯特罗格。斯特罗格为自己的自动电话交换机申请了专利，并放弃了殡葬生意，转而去批量生产他的新发明。

有个传闻说，斯特罗格的殡葬生意之所以不断流失客户，是因为一个竞争对手的妻子是电话接线员，她把所有打电话找斯特罗格的人都转给了别人。为了摆脱这位中间的接线员，他于一八八九年发明了第一台自动电话交换机，并在一八九一年获得了专利。据说，他最初是用一个圆形的衣领盒和一些大头针做出了发明的模型。
o_surface: At the end of the XIX century one american enterpreneur invented a system to withstand competition. This system we all use nowadays.
o_truth:
This american enterpreneur was Almon Brown Strowger. Strowger patented his automatic telephone exchange and left the undertaking business to mass-produce his new invention. 

 Anecdotally, Strowger's undertaking business was losing clients to a competitor whose telephone-operator wife was redirecting everyone who called for Strowger. Motivated to remove the intermediary operator, he invented the first automatic telephone exchange in 1889 and received its patent in 1891.It is reported that he initially constructed a model of his invention from a round collar box and some straight pins.

zh_surface: 一个女人从六楼的窗户跳了出去。然而，她一点也没有受伤。
zh_truth: 这个女人本想自杀，但在最后一刻改变了主意，决定跳回自己的公寓里。
o_surface: A woman jumps from a windowshell, on a 6th floor. However, she is not injured in any way.
o_truth: The woman was about to commit suicide but she changed her mind in the last minute and decided to jump back into her apartment.

zh_surface: 一个原本预计几天后才会死的男人，比他预想的死得更早。
zh_truth: 这个男人确实病得很重，他决定把自己的器官捐给一个富人。因为这个富人的儿子想继承父亲的财产，就毒死了这位器官捐献者，好让这些器官移植到父亲体内之后无法再正常工作。
o_surface: A man who was expecting to die in a few days dies sooner than he thought.
o_truth: The man was really sick and he decided to donate his organs to a rich man. Since this rich man's son wanted to inherit his farther's fortune he poisoned the donor so that his organs became unable to work again in his father's body.

zh_surface: 罗杰看到了光，然后就全身瘫痪了。不久之后，他就死了。
zh_truth: 罗杰是一只从自己居住的房子里逃出来的兔子。夜里它正在横穿马路，汽车的车灯晃花了它的眼。司机没有看见它，从它身上碾了过去。
o_surface: Roger sees the light and he becomes paralyzed. Soon after that he dies.
o_truth: Roger was a rabbit that escaped from the house where he lived. He was crossing the road at night when the lights of a car blinded him. The driver did not see him and ran him over.

zh_surface: 一个女人正计划在晚餐时杀死她的丈夫。然而，她在准备晚餐的时候自杀了。
zh_truth: 她打算用自己包里的一些药片给食物下毒来毒死他。当她去拿那些药片时，她发现它们不见了——她的儿子把它们当成糖果吞了下去。她无法承受这一切，于是结束了自己的生命。
o_surface: A woman is planning to kill her husband during dinner. However, she commits suicide while preparing it.
o_truth: She was planning to kill him by poisoning the food with some pills that she had in her bag. When she went to grab them, she noticed that they were not there, and that her son had swallowed them, thinking they were sweets. She couldn't bear it and took her own life.

zh_surface: 一个女人透过窗户往外看，看到一个拿着刀的男人。然而，她还没来得及报警就被杀害了。
zh_truth: 女人真正看到的，是凶手的倒影——凶手早已在她家里，就站在她身后。
o_surface: A woman is looking through the window and sees a man with a knife. However, she does not have enough time to call the police before being murdered.
o_truth: What the woman really saw was the reflection of the murderer, who was already inside her house, behind her.

zh_surface: 辛迪在一大群人中被人杀害。然而，没有人注意到她的哭喊。
zh_truth: 辛迪当时正在电影院看一部恐怖片。一个极其恐怖的场景开始了。就在所有人都在尖叫的时候，她身后的凶手把她杀死了。
o_surface: Cindy is amongst a crowd of people when she is murdered. However, nobody notices her cries.
o_truth: Cindy was in a movie theater, watching a horror movie. A very scary scene started. While everybody was screaming the murderer - who was behind her - was killing her.

zh_surface: 尽管停电了，马修还是不停地给儿子读睡前故事。
zh_truth: 马修是盲人，平时都用盲文书给儿子读睡前故事。那天晚上停电了，但这并没有妨碍他把故事读完。
o_surface: Matthew keeps reading a bedtime story to his son despite the blackout.
o_truth: Matthew was blind and he usually read bedtime stories to his son from a braille book. That night there was a blackout, but this did not stop him from finishing the story.

zh_surface: 如果那天晚上风没有刮得那么大，安吉拉就还活着。
zh_truth: 因为风很大，安吉拉决定去田野里放风筝。黄昏时，她看不清附近的输电塔。当风筝缠在电线上、她试着去解开时，她触电死了。
o_surface: If the wind hadn't blown so strongly that night, Angela would still be alive.
o_truth: As it was windy, Angela decided to go to a field to fly her kite. At twilight, she could not see the nearby transmission tower. When her kite got tangled in the cables and she tried to untangle them, she was electrocuted.

zh_surface: 军校学员们成了全城抢购食盐的原因。
zh_truth: 学员们本该去铲雪，但他们偷懒，往地上撒盐。为了撒盐，他们买了很多盐。当老人们看到军人买那么多盐时，以为马上就要打仗了，于是乱作一团，开始抢购食盐。
o_surface: The cadets became the cause of a mass buying up of salt in the whole city.
o_truth: Cadets were supposed to shovel the snow. But they were lazy so they strew the ground with salt. They bought lots of salt to perfrom it. When old people saw military men buying lots of salt, they thought there'll be a war soon and began to wreak havoc and buy up salt.

zh_surface: 一个男人从飞机上跳了下来，他活了下来。
zh_truth: 那架飞机并没有在飞行。
o_surface: A man jumped out of plane. And he survived.
o_truth: The plane wasn't flying.

zh_surface: 一个女人请司机送她回家。一路上她说个不停。司机对她说：“对不起，我是聋子。”女人便不做声了。但当她走出出租车时，她明白了司机并不是聋子。
zh_truth: 司机听清了、也听懂了她的家在哪儿。
o_surface: A woman asks a driver to take her home. The whole way she talks, too much. The taxist tells her: "I'm sorry but I am deaf." The woman falls silent. But when she goes out of the taxi, she understands that the driver isn't deaf.
o_truth: The taxist have heard and understood where her house was.

zh_surface: 一个男人发现，不用自己这二十年来一直戴着的助听器，他反而听得更清楚，他非常愤怒。他去找医生投诉，可那位专科医生比他还要愤怒。
zh_truth: 这个男人把助听器戴在了他那只健康的耳朵上。
o_surface: A man was furious, when he realized that he can hear better without hearing aid that he was using the last 20 years. He went to his doctor to complain but the specialist became even more furious than him.
o_truth: The man was wearing the hearing aid on his healthy ear.

zh_surface: 一个男人走在街上，突然掐住了从他身边走过的女人的脖子。他被带到了警察局，但不久就被释放了。
zh_truth: 这个女人是他的妻子。几年前她伪造了自己的死亡，而她的丈夫被判定有罪。他如今已经出狱，不能因为同一桩罪行再被定罪一次。
o_surface: A man was walking down the street when he suddenly started to choke the woman walking by him. He was taken to the police station but soon after was released.
o_truth: This woman was his wife. Some years ago she staged her death and her husband was found guilty. He already got out of jail and now can not be convicted for the same crime one more time.

zh_surface: 学员们正在军事学院参加考试。其中一个人抽了一张考签，回到座位上准备。几分钟后，他走到教授面前，一言不发地把自己的记分册交给教授，然后离开了教室。这个学生得了优秀。
zh_truth: 这是一场摩尔斯电码考试。考试期间，教授一直在敲击一条电码，内容是说：任何学生都可以走到他面前，领取优秀成绩。
o_surface: Students are taking an exam at military academy. One of them chooses a ticket and goes to his seat to get prepared. After some minutes he goes to the professor, silently gives him the student's record-book and leaves the classroom. The student got the excellent.
o_truth: It was a morse code exam. During exam, the professor was tapping the message saying that any student may come up to him and get the excelllent.

zh_surface: 一个戴着面罩的男人腋下夹着一幅画从博物馆里跑出来。一名警察看见了他，开枪将他击毙，不久后自己也自杀了。几天后，那个拿着画的男人被安葬，并被追认为这座城市最受爱戴的儿子。
zh_truth: 在一段寒潮期间，博物馆发生了火灾，馆长试图从馆藏中抢救出最珍贵的那幅画。那名警察没有注意到火灾，以为拿着画的男人是小偷。他命令对方站住别动，但因为馆长是聋子，他没有听见警察的话。当警察意识到自己做了什么之后，他自杀了。
o_surface: A man wearing a balaclava runs out of a museum carrying a painting under his arm. A police officer sees him, shoots him dead and commits suicide soon after. A couple of days later, the man with the painting is buried and named favorite son of the city.
o_truth: During a cold spell, there is fire in a museum and its director tried to save the most valuable painting from the museum's collection. The police officer had not noticed the fire and thought the man with the painting was a thief. He told him to freeze but since the director was deaf he did not hear the police officer. When the police officer realized what he had done, he committed suicide.

zh_surface: 杰克带着罗盘去旅行。走了很久之后，他停下来吃了个三明治。之后他再也找不到回去的路了。
zh_truth: 杰克是一位在北极附近工作的科学家。他散步时一路朝北走，停下来吃三明治的地方恰好就是北极点。当他想要回家时，他的罗盘失灵了，因为每一个方向都指向南方。
o_surface: Jack goes on a trip with his compass. After a long walk, he stops to eat a sandwich. He is not able to find his way back afterwards.
o_truth: Jack was a scientist who worked near the North Pole. When he went walking, he walked towards the north and he stopped to eat his sandwich exactly at the North Pole. When he tried to return home, his compass was useless, since every direction pointed South.

zh_surface: 彼得在抽签中中签，然后他自杀了。
zh_truth: 一群人被大雪困住了。他们决定用抽签来决定谁该死去，这样其他人就能吃他（她）的尸体活下去。彼得被抽中了，所以他必须自己结束生命。
o_surface: Peter wins the raffle and commits suicide.
o_truth: A group of people were snowed in. They decided to do a raffle to decide who should die so the others could eat his/her corpse to stay alive. Peter's name was selected so he had to take his own life.

zh_surface: 迈克尔设法让自己中了枪；这样做反而救了他自己的命。
zh_truth: 迈克尔是前线上的一名士兵。一场大进攻的日子临近了。趁其他士兵都没注意的时候，他把一条胳膊伸了出去，好让敌人朝它开枪。随后他被送进了医院，他的生命也就不再有危险了。
o_surface: Michael manages to get shot; in doing so he saves his own life.
o_truth: Michael was a soldier on the battlefront. The day of a big attack was approaching. When none of the other soldiers were looking, he put out an arm, so that the enemy would shoot at it. He was then taken to the hospital, and his life was no longer in danger.

zh_surface: 一个推销员为了做成买卖太用力了，结果反而丢掉了自己的命。
zh_truth: 这个推销员卖的是防弹衣。有一天，为了向一位顾客证明产品的质量，他穿上一件，坚持让顾客开枪打他。顾客答应了，但不幸的是他打偏了，一枪打在了推销员的头上。
o_surface: A salesman tries too hard to get a sale and as a result ends up dying.
o_truth: The salesman sold bulletproof vests. One day, to prove the quality of his product to a customer, he put one of them on and insisted the client to shoot him. The client accepted but unfortunately he missed the shot and shot the salesman in the head.

zh_surface: 一个男人在一大群人面前杀死了自己的弟弟。然而，没有一个人举报他。
zh_truth: 这个男人是刽子手，而他的弟弟被判了死刑。
o_surface: A man kills his brother in front of a crowd of people. However, no one reports him.
o_truth: The man worked as executioner and his brother had been sentenced to death.

zh_surface: 弗朗西斯在工作中因心脏病发作而死。事情发生时他的同事们就在场。然而，直到弗朗西斯死去，他们都没有去叫人来救他。
zh_truth: 弗朗西斯是一名戏剧演员，在一场演出中间突发心脏病。然而，他演的角色正是一个心脏病发作的人。因此，他的同事和观众都只以为他的表演非常震撼。
o_surface: Francis dies of a heart attack at work. His colleagues are there when it happens. However, they do not call for help until Francis dies.
o_truth: Francis was a theather actor and suffered a heart attack in the middle of a performance. However, he was playing someone who was having a heart attack. Therefore, both his colleagues and the audience simply thought that he was giving a really impressive performance.

zh_surface: 一个男人被发现死在田野里。他旁边躺着一个没有打开的包裹。
zh_truth: 这个男人在跳伞，他的降落伞没有打开。那个没打开的包裹就是他的降落伞。
o_surface: A man is found dead in a filed. Lying next to him is an unopened package.
o_truth: The man was skydiving and his parachute did not open. The unopened package was his parachute.

zh_surface: 一个女人刚穿好衣服，就死了。
zh_truth: 她的一只鞋子里有一只非常毒的蜘蛛。当女人穿上鞋时，蜘蛛咬了她。
o_surface: A woman finishes getting dressed and dies.
o_truth: There was a very venomous spider in one of her shoes. When the woman put on her shoes, the spider bit her.

zh_surface: 一对舞者在一场舞蹈比赛前后死去。
zh_truth: 在一场探戈比赛中，另一对求胜心切的舞者给那对舞者在表演中相互传递的玫瑰下了毒，想让这对舞者死掉。有毒的玫瑰杀死了这对舞者，而另一对赢得了比赛。
o_surface: A couple of dancers die around a dance competition.
o_truth: During a tango competition, another - very competitive - couple poisoned the rose that another couple passed each other during their routine, so that the couple would die. The poisoned rose killed this couple and the others won the contest.

zh_surface: 一个女人走进宠物店想买一只鹦鹉。卖家向她推荐了一只，说它能重复它听到的一切。几天后，这个女人觉得自己上当了，回到店里要求退钱。然而，她带回家的还是那只鹦鹉，而不是她的钱。
zh_truth: 这只鹦鹉是聋的。它什么也听不见，所以什么也重复不了。然而卖家没有把钱退给女人，因为他从来没有对她说过谎。
o_surface: A woman walks into a pet store to buy a parrot. The seller offers her one, telling her that it can repeat everything it hears. Some days later the woman - feeling cheated - goes back into the store to get her money back. However, she comes back home with the parrot and not her money.
o_truth: The parrot was deaf. It could not repeat anything, since it could not hear anything. However, the seller did not return the money to the woman because he never lied to her.

zh_surface: 在一辆汽车的前座，一个女人被发现已经死亡。后座上有一把枪，她够不到。车窗都关着，车门也都锁着。
zh_truth: 这个女人坐在一辆敞篷车里，车顶是敞开的。凶手开枪打死了她，把枪扔到了汽车的后座上。
o_surface: In the front of a car, a woman is found dead. There is a gun in the back seat, out of her reach. The windows are closed and the doors are all locked.
o_truth: The woman was sitting in a convertible and the top was down. The murderer shot her and threw the gun into the back seat of the car.

zh_surface: 在死去之前的那一刻，她以为那是她一生中最美好的一天。
zh_truth: 一场戏剧演出结束时，女主角出场，观众开始鼓掌。就在这时，布景出了故障，开始在舞台上塌下来。观众从座位上站起来尖叫，想提醒女演员，可她却以为那是全场起立鼓掌，结果被压死了。
o_title: The best day of her life
o_surface: She thought that it was the best day of her life moments before she died.
o_truth: At the end of a theather play, the lead actress appeared and the audience began to applaud. At that time there was a failure with the scenery and it started to collapse on stage. The oublic rose from their seats screaming, trying to warn the actress but she thought it was a standing ovation and she was crushed.

zh_surface: 杰克和朱迪躺在地上死了。地板上有一摊水，还有碎玻璃。他们是怎么死的？
zh_truth: 杰克和朱迪是两条金鱼，游在一个放在架子上的小鱼缸里。一天下午，一只猫从窗户溜进房间，撞到了鱼缸，鱼缸从架子上掉下来，摔在地上碎了。
o_surface: Jack and Judy were lying on the floor dead. There was a puddle of water and broken glass on the floor. How did they die?
o_truth: Jack and Judy were two goldfish that swam in a small aquarium placed on a shelf. One afternoon, a cat sneaked into the room through the window and hit the aquarium that fell off the shelf and broke against the ground.

zh_surface: 吉米藏了一份宝藏，但当他想把它找回来时，却怎么都找不到了。
zh_truth: 吉米八岁时埋下了一份宝藏。小时候他写下了一张字条，记着要走多少步才能找到他的宝藏。但现在他长大了，步子比以前大得多，所以他再也找不到那份宝藏了。
o_surface: Jimmy hid a treasure but when he wanted to recover it, he was not able to.
o_truth: Jimmy buried a treasure when he was 8 years old. He had written a note when he was younger with how many steps he would take to find his treasure. But now that he was grown up, his stride was much longer and he could never find his treasure.

zh_surface: 一个男人醒着躺在床上。他打了一个电话，什么也没说，然后就睡了。
zh_truth: 他住在一家旅馆里，因为隔壁房间的男人打呼噜而睡不着。他打电话给那个打呼噜的人（在这家旅馆，和许多旅馆一样，电话号码是根据房间号编的）。打呼噜的人被吵醒，接了电话。这个男人什么也没说就挂断了，并且在对方再次打起呼噜之前睡着了。
o_surface: A man is lying awake in bed. He makes a phone call, says nothing, and goes to sleep.
o_truth: He is in a hotel and is unable to sleep because the man in the adjacent room is snoring. He calls the snorer up (at this hotel, like many others, the phone numbers are based on the room number). The snorer wakes up and answers. The first man hangs up without saying anything and goes to sleep before the snorer starts snoring again.

zh_surface: 一个女人被食物包围着，却还是饿死了。
zh_truth: 这个女人在一家大型食品公司的仓库里工作。假期期间，她独自一人，不小心把自己锁在了里面。由于所有食物都是罐头，而她又没有任何可以打开罐头的东西，她最终饿死了。
o_surface: A woman starves to death despite being surrounded by food.
o_truth: The woman worked in the stores of a large food company. During the holiday period, she was alone and locked herself in by accident. As all the food was canned and she had nothing to open the cans with, she starved to death.

zh_surface: 经过周密的策划，五个男人闯进一栋房子，从里面拿走了数千美元现金。房子的主人是唯一被逮捕的人。
zh_truth: 这五个男人是警察，他们持有搜查令，要进入一名黑帮分子的家并没收他的全部钱财。在策划好这次行动之后，他们逮捕了房子的主人。
o_surface: After careful planning, five men break into a house and take thousands of dollars in cash from it. The owner of the house is the only person arrested.
o_truth: The five men were policemen and they had an arrest warrant to enter a mobster's house and take all his money. After planning the assault, they arrested the house's owner.

zh_surface: 一名脱衣舞娘去赴一场与一个男人的私人约会。在他们所在的房间里，她脱掉了上衣和胸罩。男人走近，看着她的胸部笑了。不久之后，她穿好衣服，付钱给那个男人，然后离开了。
zh_truth: 这个女人几天前刚做过隆胸手术，她预约了自己的私人医生来复查手术效果。医生看到一切都很完美，自己做得非常出色。最后，女人付了账单，离开了诊所。
o_surface: An exotic dancer goes on a date for a private session with a man. In the room where they are, she takes her shirt and bra off. The man approaches, watches her breasts and smiles. Soon after, she dresses herself up, pays the man and leaves.
o_truth: The woman had undergone a breast augmentation surgery a few days earlier and she had arranged an appointment with her private doctor to review the result of the operation. The man saw that everything was perfect and that he had done a great job. Finally the woman paid the bill and left the clinic.

zh_surface: 乔治试图去拥抱一个人之后，溺水身亡了。
zh_truth: 乔治当时喝醉了，在河面上看见了自己的倒影。由于醉得厉害，他觉得去拥抱那个“陌生人”是个好主意。然而，这让他掉进了河里，溺水而死。
o_surface: After George tries to hug a person, he dies by drowning.
o_truth: George was under the influence of alcohol and saw his reflection on a river. As he was intoxicated, he thought that it would be a good idea to give a hug to the "stranger". However this caused him to fall into the river and drown.

zh_surface: 一只黑猫正走在路中间，路上有一盏坏掉的路灯。一个男人开着车，车头灯也坏了。尽管如此，他还是避开了猫，没有伤害到它。
zh_truth: 男人之所以能避开猫，是因为当时是白天。
o_surface: A black cat is walking through the middle of a road where there is a broken street lamp. A man is driving his vehicle with headlights that do not work. Despite all of this, he is able to avoid harming the cat.
o_truth: The man avoided the cat because it was daylight.

zh_surface: 莉兹正要查出是谁杀了马里奥时，她睡着了。醒来后她意识到，她再也查不出答案了。
zh_truth: 莉兹正在海滩上读一本小说。书中的主人公马里奥被人杀害，她正要查出凶手是谁。还没查出来，她就睡着了，书被丢在沙子上。醒来时，她看到潮水涨了上来，书已经被冲走了。
o_surface: When Liz was about to find out who killed Mario, she fell asleep. When she woke up she realized that she could no longer find it out.
o_truth: Liz was reading a novel on the beach. The main character, Mario, had been killed and she was about to find out who had committed the crime. Before she found it out, she fell asleep with the book lying in the sand. When she woke up she saw that the tide had risen and the book had been washed away.

zh_surface: 一名女子被发现死在医院里。凶器是一把剪刀。然而，尸体上没有任何伤口。
zh_truth: 女子的病情十分危急，医生把她接在一台维持她生命的仪器上。凶手只是用剪刀剪断了那台仪器的电线，结束了她的生命。
o_surface: A woman is found dead in a hospital. The murder weapon is a pair of scissors. However, the body has no cuts ot wounds of any kind.
o_truth: The woman's condition was critical, and the doctors had connected her to a device that kept her alive. The murderer simply cut the wires off that device with scissors to end her life.

zh_surface: 一个女人走进图书馆，拿起一本书，大哭起来。
zh_truth: 这个女人是一位作家，她把自己写的一本书捐给了图书馆。她在书页里夹了一张五十美元的钞票，作为送给第一个借这本书的人的礼物。一年之后，她回到图书馆，拿起那本书，发现钞票还在里面。意识到没有人读过她的书，她放声大哭。
o_surface: A woman goes to the library, takes a book and cries out.
o_truth: The woman was a writer and she had donated one of her books to the library. She had included a 50$ bill among the pages as a gift for the first person borrowing the book. After a year, she came back to the library, took the book and saw that the bill was still there. Realizing that no one had read her book she burst into tears.

zh_surface: 一个女人向她的朋友——一位警察——询问一桩离奇的死亡。五分钟后，警察惊讶地发现，女人查出了死因。
zh_truth: 女人和警察是朋友，他们正在玩“情境猜谜”游戏。警察讲了一个故事，以为他的朋友猜不出来。当女人只问了几个问题就找出答案时，他非常惊讶。
o_surface: A woman asks questions to her friend - a policeman - about a strange death. After 5 minutes the policeman is surprised to see that the woman finds out the cause of the death.
o_truth: The woman and the policeman were friends and they were playing "situation puzzle". The policeman told a story and thought that his friend could not solve it. He was very surprised when the woman, after a few questions, found out the solution.

zh_surface: 一个男人砸烂了吉米的豪车。尽管吉米亲眼看着自己的车被砸，他却没有做出任何阻止的举动。
zh_truth: 吉米和那个男人打了赌。两人约定，赌输的一方要被赢家砸车。吉米赌输了。
o_surface: A man smashes Jimmy's luxury car. Althought Jimmy saw his car get smashed he made no attempt to stop the man.
o_truth: Jimmy and the other man had a bet. It was agreed that the winner of the bet would smash the loser's car. Jimmy lost the bet.

zh_surface: 约翰喜欢来这里有很多原因。但他的妻子玛丽讨厌这个地方，城里其他女人也一样。为什么？
zh_truth: 这个故事谜题讲的是一处真实的地理景观。在斯德哥尔摩，有一条不到一米宽的窄巷，通往一家酒馆。这条巷子在18世纪非常受欢迎，因为醉汉可以扶着墙壁走过巷子。但他们的妻子进不了这条巷子，因为她们的裙撑卡在了墙壁之间。
o_surface: There were many reasons why John enjoyed coming here. But his wife Mary hated this place, as did other women in the city. Why?
o_truth: This situation puzzle is about a real geographical object. In Stockholm, there’s a narrow – no more than a meter wide – street that leads to a drinking place. It was very popular in the 18th century, as drunkards could hold on to the walls when walking along the street. However, their wives couldn’t enter this street, because their hooped dresses got stuck between the walls.

zh_surface: 乔治上数学课迟到了，还误解了老师。这却给他带来了奖励和认可！发生了什么？
zh_truth: 有一次，美国数学家乔治·丹齐格上这门课迟到了很久。他看到黑板上写着几道题，以为那是家庭作业。他花了好几天时间去解它们，最终找出了答案。原来，他解开了两道许多科学家都苦苦钻研的“无解”难题。
o_surface: George was late for a math class and misunderstood the teacher. This brought him a reward and recognition! What happened?
o_truth: Once, the American mathematician George Danzig came very late for a class. He saw some problems written on the blackboard and decided that these were a homework task. He spent several days working on them and eventually found the answers. It turned out that he found the key to two “unsolvable” problems that many scientists were wrestling with.

zh_surface: 过去，房东常常拖欠付给盖房和修房的人的工钱，甚至不付钱就把他们赶走。但工匠们想出了一个不寻常的办法，立刻让房东们全额付清了工钱。他们做了什么？
zh_truth: 在给房子打地基或修房子时，他们会在某个地方放一个生鸡蛋。过了一段时间，鸡蛋开始腐烂。如果房东叫来工匠并付清了工钱，他们就把鸡蛋取走。如果他把他们赶走，鸡蛋最终会发出恶臭，而且很难找到它被藏在哪儿。
o_surface: Landlords used to delay payment to people who built and repaired houses or even booted them out without money. But the builders came up with an uncommon move, which immediately made the landlords pay them in full. What did they do?
o_truth: When laying a foundation for a house or repairing it, they put a raw egg in a certain place. After a while, it began to rot. If the landlord called the builders and paid for their work, they took the egg away. If he booted them out, the egg eventually began to stink, and it was very difficult to find where it had been hidden.

zh_surface: 一位画家接了一单生意，要给一个非常丑陋又傲慢的女人画肖像。所有人都劝他别接，说她一分钱都不会付，因为这幅肖像肯定画得很差。结果果真如此。但两天后，那个女人又回来了，恳求画家把肖像卖给她。为什么？
zh_truth: 画家把肖像送去参加展览，并给它取名为《铁公鸡》。这引起了流言蜚语，那个女人只好请求画家把肖像从展览上撤下来。
o_surface: An artist took an order to paint a portrait of a very ugly and arrogant woman. Everyone tried to dissuade him, claiming that she wouldn’t pay a penny, because the portrait would be bad. And so it happened. But two days later, the woman returned and begged the artist to sell her the portrait. Why?
o_truth: The artist sent the portrait to an exhibition and called it The Penny Pincher. It triggered gossips, and the woman had to ask the artist to remove the portrait from the exhibition.

zh_surface:
午夜差五分钟时，我在东京郊区上了电车。车厢里除了我，只有另外几个人。这时一个男人走了进来。他环视了一下车厢，车门刚一关上，他的脸就因恐惧而扭曲了。

他走到一个女孩面前。

——“打扰一下，女士，你今年28岁吗？”

——“是的！”她回答，“你怎么猜到的？”

他无视了她的问题，转向坐在旁边的男人。

——“那你……你45岁？”

——“对，没错！”

他看向我。

——“你35岁。”

——“没错，可你是怎么知道的？”

——“还有你，小姐，你50岁了？”

——“对，一点不错，不过明天我就51岁了……更确切地说，再过五分钟。”

听她这么说，那个男人的脸变得惨白。为什么？
zh_truth: 那个有预言能力的男人能看到别人还能活多少年。他意识到电车将在不到五分钟内发生事故，车上所有乘客都会死。
o_title: A train on the outskirts of Tokyo
o_surface:
At five minutes to midnight, I took the train on the outskirts of Tokyo. There were only me and a few other people in the carriage when a man entered. He looked around the carriage and as soon as the doors closed, his face was convulsed with horror. 

 He approached a girl.

– Excuse me, ma’am, are you 28 years old?

– Yes! – she replied – How did you guess? 

 He ignored her question and moved on to the man sitting next to him. 

 – And you... are you 45?

– Yes, right! 

 He looked at me. 

 – And you’re 35.

– That’s right, but how do you know? 

 – And you, miss, are you 50?

– Yes, exactly, but tomorrow I’ll be 51... or rather, in 5 minutes. 

 When she said that, the man’s face turned white as a sheet. Why?
o_truth: The man with prophetic gift could see how many years others would live. He realized that the train would crash in less than 5 minutes and all the passengers would die.

zh_surface:
有一天，我受够了我妹妹的哭闹声，于是杀了她，把她的尸体扔进一口井里。第二天，尸体不见了。

几年后，我和一个朋友为一件小事吵了起来，我决定把他也杀掉，扔进那口井里。第二天，尸体不见了。

后来，我喝醉了酒，不小心让一个女孩怀了孕。我杀了她，也把她扔进了同一口井。第二天，她的尸体像其他尸体一样不见了。

十年后，我的老板把我逼疯了。我杀了他，用同一口井处理了尸体。一天后，他的尸体不见了。

不久之后，我需要把妈妈送进养老院，但钱不够，于是我杀了她，把她扔进了井里。第二天，尸体却还在那里。为什么？
zh_truth: 主人公的母亲一直在把井里的尸体拖走。当然，她没办法拖走自己的尸体。
o_surface:
One day, I felt fed up with my younger sister’s bleat. So, I killed her and threw her body into a well. The next day, the body disappeared. 

 A few years later, I quarreled with a friend over a trifle and decided to kill him too and to throw his body into the well. The next day, the body disappeared. 

 Later, I was drunk and accidentally impregnated a girl. I killed her and threw her into the same well. The next day, her body disappeared, as all the others did. 

 10 years later, my boss drove me nuts. I killed him and disposed of the body in the same well. A day later, his body disappeared. 

 Shortly thereafter, I needed to send my mom to a nursing home, but I didn’t have enough money for that, so I killed her and threw her into the well. The next day, the body was still there. Why?
o_truth: The main character’s mother dragged corpses away out of the well. Of course, she couldn’t drag her own corpse away.

zh_surface:
一个小女孩在谷仓里哭得很伤心。透过泪水，她注意到垃圾堆里躺着一盏旧油灯。她把它捡起来，擦掉了上面的灰。

突然，一个精灵出现了，说：

“我可以实现你一个愿望。但只能实现一个，所以好好想想。”

“请让我的父母消失！”女孩流着泪说，“我恨他们！”

“就当这事已经办成了，”精灵回答，“去睡觉吧，明天早上你的愿望就会实现。”

第二天早上，女孩醒来，下楼走进厨房。她看到爸爸妈妈正坐在餐桌旁吃早餐。女孩立刻后悔了自己的愿望。她冲进谷仓，开始擦那盏灯。

精灵出现了，说：“怎么样，你现在开心了吗？”

“请取消我昨天的愿望，”女孩恳求道。

“很抱歉，”精灵回答，“但愿望一旦许下，我就没法取消了。”

女孩放声大哭。为什么？
zh_truth: 女孩意识到自己一直和养父母住在一起，而她的愿望让住在别处的亲生父母消失了。
o_surface:
A little girl was crying bitterly in a barn. Through her tears, she noticed an old lamp lying in the garbage. She took it and dusted it off. 

 Suddenly a genie appeared and said: 

 "I’ll fulfill one of your wishes. But only one, so think it over." 

 "Please make my parents disappear!" the girl said through tears, "I hate them!" 

 "Consider it done," replied the genie. "Go to bed, and in the morning your wish will be fulfilled." 

 The next morning, the girl woke up and went down to the kitchen. She found her mom and dad sitting at the kitchen table having breakfast. The girl immediately regretted her wish. She rushed into the barn and began to rub the lamp. 

 The genie appeared and said, "Well, are you happy now?" 

 "Please cancel my yesterday’s wish," the girl pleaded. 

 "I'm sorry," the genie replied. "But once a wish is made, I can’t cancel it." 

 And the girl burst into bitter tears. Why?
o_truth: The girl realized that she lived with foster parents, and her wish made her real parents, who lived somewhere else, disappear.

zh_surface:
今天，我又在电车上，一个女人出现在我面前。我甚至不记得她的脸。太悲伤了。

请解释叙述者为什么感到悲伤。
zh_truth: 这个故事是一位电车司机讲的，他撞上了一个突然跳到铁轨上的女人。
o_surface:
Today, I was on the train again when a woman appeared before me. I didn’t even remember her face. It’s so sad. 

 

Explain why the narrator feels sad.
o_truth: This story was told by a train operator that hit a woman who suddenly jumped out onto the railway.

zh_surface: 有一天，一个男人收到一个邮包。里面小心翼翼地包着一条人的手臂。他检查了一下，重新包好，然后把它寄给了另一个男人。第二个男人也仔细检查了那条手臂，然后把它带到树林里埋掉了。他们为什么这么做？
zh_truth: 这三个男人曾经被困在一座荒岛上。为了活下去，他们商量好各自砍下自己的左臂来吃。他们立下誓言，每个人都必须被砍掉左臂。其中一个人是医生，他砍下了两个同伴的手臂。后来他们获救了。但他的誓言依然有效，所以后来他也必须把自己的手臂切下来，寄给他的同伴。
o_title: The Arm of the Postal Service
o_surface: One day a man received a parcel in the post. Carefully packed inside was a human arm. He examined it, repacked it and then sent it on to another man. The second man also carefully examined the arm before taking it to the woods and burying it. Why did they do this?
o_truth:
The three men had been stranded on a desert island. Desperate for food, they had agreed to amputate their left arms in order to eat them. They swore an oath that each would have his left arm cut off. One of them was a doctor and he cut the arms off his two companions. They were then rescued. But his oath was still binding so he later had to have his arm amputated and sent to his colleagues. 

 This is often told with a further twist whereby a doctor pays a tramp a large sum in order to amputate the tramp's arm which the doctor then sends to another man who inspects it etc. This variation can make for a long night of questioning!

zh_surface: 每天他都涂着绿色的口红。但几乎没有人注意到。
zh_truth: 在20世纪，电视还是黑白的，而摄像机装有红色滤镜，会吸收画面中的红色，也就是说，红色口红在嘴唇上根本看不出来。因此，电视播音员不得不涂绿色的口红，好让嘴唇显得更鲜明。
o_surface: Every day he puts on green lipstick. But almost no one notices it.
o_truth: In the 20th century the television was still black and white, and cameras had red filters, which absorbed red color of the image, i.e., red lipstick couldn’t be seen on the lips. Therefore, TV broadcasters had to make up their lips with green lipstick to make them look more expressive.

zh_surface: 宿舍里的一顿晚餐。灯灭了。当他们把灯打开时，一个学生满手是血。
zh_truth: 盘子里只剩最后一根香肠。灯灭的时候，所有学生都拿叉子去抢那根香肠，而这个人却用手去抓。
o_surface: A dinner at a dormitory. The light went out. When they turned on the light, a student had blood all over his hands.
o_truth: There was the last sausage left on the plate. When the light went out, all the students reached for the sausage with their forks, and this one with his hands.

zh_surface:
父母的小女儿在操场上玩耍时失踪了。警方没有找到她。案子被认定无法侦破，调查也随之结案。

但父母拒绝放弃。他们决定联系一位灵媒。这位灵媒经常协助警方，常常能指出罪犯或失踪者的确切位置。

几天后，灵媒来了，她请父母带她去他们最后一次见到女儿的地方。母亲和父亲把灵媒带到公园，看着她坐到草地上，闭上眼睛，进入恍惚状态。然后她大声说：“你们的女儿还活着！她的心脏在跳动，她的肺在呼吸。”

这对欣喜的父母紧紧握住了彼此的手。母亲问：“可她现在在哪里？”

“她看到一栋豪华的房子，里面摆着昂贵的家具，”灵媒继续说，“而她的胃里只有最美味的食物。”

母亲又松了一口气，恳求道：“可我们的女儿到底在哪儿？请告诉我们！”

灵媒犹豫了一会儿。然后她的眼睛睁得大大的，尖叫道：“她遍布全世界！”

有一阵子，失踪女孩的父母目瞪口呆地站在原地一动不动。接着他们突然明白了灵媒的意思，瘫倒在地，放声痛哭。

女孩出了什么事？
zh_truth: 女孩被绑架后，器官被卖掉了。
o_surface:
The parents lost their little daughter when she was playing on the playground. The police didn’t find her. The case was deemed as unsolved, and the investigation was closed. 

 But the parents refused to give up. And they decided to contact a medium. This medium often helped the police and could often point out the exact location of a criminal or a missing person. 

 When the medium arrived a few days later, she asked the parents to take her to the place where they had last seen their daughter. The mother and father took the medium to the park and watched her sit down on the grass, close her eyes, and do into a trance. Then she exclaimed, “Your daughter is alive! Her heart is beating and her lungs are breathing.” 

 The happy parents held hands tightly. The mother asked, “But where is she now?” 

 “She sees a luxurious house with expensive furniture,” the medium continued, “And only the most delicious food is in her stomach”. 

 The mother breathed a sigh of relief again and pleaded, "But where is our daughter? Please tell us!" 

 The medium hesitated for a while. Then her eyes opened wide, and she screamed, "She’s all over the world!" 

 For a while, the parents of the missing girl stood motionless with their mouths wide open. Then they suddenly understood what the medium meant and fell on the floor, crying bitterly. 

 What happened to the girl?
o_truth: The girl was kidnapped and sold for organs.

zh_surface: 由于尼尔斯工作时犯的一个疏忽，楼上的邻居玛莎没法洗碗。同时，玛莎的丈夫却很高兴，但尼尔斯还是被解雇了。为什么？
zh_truth: 挪威发生过一件有趣的事：一位家庭主妇（玛莎）打开水龙头时，里面流出来的竟然是啤酒！原来，一楼咖啡馆里的一个酒保把两个水龙头接错了。结果，玛莎家楼上喷出了啤酒，而楼下酒吧的啤酒龙头里却喷出了水。当然，那个酒保被解雇了，但玛莎的丈夫很高兴。
o_surface: Due to an oversight committed by Nils when doing his job, Martha, an upstairs neighbour, couldn’t wash the dishes. At the same time, Martha’s husband was glad, but Nils was still fired. Why?
o_truth:
An interesting case happened in Norway: 

 When a housewife (Martha) turned on a water tap, beer poured out of it! The fact is that in a cafe on the ground floor, a bartender confused taps. As a result, Martha had a beer jet upstairs, and in the bar below, water splashed from the beer tap. Of course, the bartender was fired, but Martha’s husband was happy.

zh_surface: 伊娃是个怀疑论者，从不相信超自然现象。但在她独自一人在一片阴森的森林里待了三个夜晚之后，她的怀疑就消失了。为什么？
zh_truth: 伊娃去了那片名声很糟的阴森森林，自然，和所有怀疑论者一样，她一路拍照，记录自己的每一步。回家后，她开始翻看照片，却发现自己睡在帐篷里的几张照片。
o_surface: Eva was a skeptic, and never believed in the paranormal. But after she had spent 3 nights in a creepy forest all alone, her skepticism disappeared. Why?
o_truth: Eva visited the ill-reputed creepy forest, and naturally, like all skeptics, she took photos and recorded her every step. After she returned home and started flipping the photos, she discovered a couple of pictures of her sleeping in a tent.

zh_surface: 在一条漂亮的路上，有一个完全正常运营的公交车站。然而，没有任何公共交通在这里停靠。为什么？
zh_truth: 这个车站在德国，紧邻一家收治老年痴呆症患者的养老院。站牌上挂着几班据称会经过的公交线路时刻表。那些想溜出去的老人会走到车站，坐下来，老老实实地等他们的公交车。如果养老院的工作人员发现某位住户已经失踪很久，他们就直接去车站把人接回来。
o_surface: On a beautiful road, there’s a bus stop that is fully operational. However, no public transport stops there. Why?
o_truth:
This stop is in Germany next to a nursing home for senile dementia patients. It has a schedule of supposedly passing bus routes hanging on it. Old men and old women who tried to tail off, went to the bus stop, sat down and humbly waited for their bus.

 

If the nursing home employees noticed that one of the inhabitants had been missing for a long time, they just went and picked them up from the bus stop.

zh_surface:
第一天，玛丽的举动没有让约翰感到任何意外。

第二天，约翰感到极其惊讶。

第三天，约翰明白了，并且对女人的看法好转了。
zh_truth:
玛丽是个女人，她有一个有钱的丈夫，还有一个有钱的情人。两个人都喜欢送她昂贵的礼物，却只给她很少的零花钱。

——第一天，玛丽和丈夫来到店里，挑了一件价值两千美元的连衣裙。丈夫当场付了钱，店员（约翰）并不感到意外。

——第二天，玛丽和情人来到同一家店，挑了和昨天一模一样的那件连衣裙。情人当场付了钱，店员约翰非常惊讶。

——第三天，玛丽一个人来到店里，退掉了其中一件连衣裙，拿回了两千美元现金。约翰果然佩服得五体投地。
o_surface:
On first day, nothing in Mary’s behavior surprised John.

On the second day, John was extremely surprised.

On the third day, John got it and switched his opinion about women for the better.
o_truth:
Mary was a woman with a rich husband and a rich lover. Both enjoyed giving her expensive gifts but gave her very little pocket money. 

 

 - On the first day, Mary and her husband came to the store and chose a dress that cost $2,000. The husband paid at once, and the store assistant (John) wasn’t surprised. 

 - On the second day, Mary came to the same store with her lover and chose just the same dress as yesterday. The lover paid at once, and John the seller was very surprised. 

 - On the third day, Mary came to the store alone and returned one of the dresses, receiving $2,000 in cash. Indeed, John was lost in admiration.

zh_surface: 听完律师的发言后，比尔的处罚反而加重了。为什么？
zh_truth: 秋天，一家地区法院正在审理一个无家可归的男人砸坏商店橱窗的案子。由于律师的那番发言，法庭虽然倾向于判处缓刑，却最终判了实刑。律师说：“冬天就要来了！无家可归的人可能会死。你们难道不明白，只有在监狱里，被告才会有鞋穿、有衣穿、有饭吃……”
o_surface: After the barrister’s speech, Bill’s punishment was upgraded. Why?
o_truth:
In autumn, a district court was hearing a case of a homeless man who had broken a shop window. Because of the barrister’s speech, the court, although drifting toward a conditional sentence, convicted the criminal. 

 

 The barrister said: “Winter is coming! A homeless man can die. Don’t you understand that only in prison the defendant will have shoes, clothes, and food…”.

zh_surface: 一个丈母娘非常讨厌自己的女婿，想毒死他。但女婿很谨慎，只吃丈母娘吃过的同样的东西。一天吃晚饭时，丈母娘把一块肉切成两半，自己吃了一块，把另一半给了女婿。之后他就死了。她是怎么做到的？
zh_truth: 她在刀的一面上涂了毒。
o_surface: A mother-in-law disliked her son-in-law so much that she wanted to poison him. But the son-in-law was careful and always ate only what his mother-in-law ate. Over dinner one night, the mother-in-law cut a piece of meat in half, ate one half herself, and gave the other to her son-in-law. After that he died. How did she manage to do it?
o_truth: She greased one side of the knife with poison.

zh_surface: 夏洛克·福尔摩斯正沿着走廊走。突然，他听到一个女人尖叫：“求你了，约翰，别杀我！”一声枪响。福尔摩斯冲进房间。一个角落里躺着一个死去的女人和一把枪。另一个角落里站着一个邮差、一个律师和一个会计。夏洛克看了看他们，走向邮差，抓住他：“我要以杀害这个女人的罪名逮捕你。”杀人的确实是那个邮差，但福尔摩斯是怎么知道的？
zh_truth: 邮差是唯一的一个男人。律师和会计都是女人。
o_surface: Sherlock Holmes was walking down the corridor. Suddenly he heard a woman screaming, “Please, John, don’t kill me!” A shot rang. Holmes burst into the room. In one corner lay a dead woman and a gun. In another corner stood a postman, a lawyer, and an accountant. Sherlock looked at them, approached the postman, and grabbed him: “I will arrest you for killing this woman.” It was really the postman who killed this woman, but how could Holmes know it?
o_truth: The postman was the only man. The lawyer and the accountant were women.

zh_surface: 一个男人手指上戴着金戒指走在路上。突然，强盗袭击了他。他们想抢走戒指，却怎么也摘不下来。于是他们砍下了他的手指，然后逃走了。然而，这个男人甚至没有尖叫。为什么？
zh_truth: 他有金牙，他不想让人看见，免得强盗连金牙也一起抢走。
o_surface: A man was walking with a gold ring on his finger. Suddenly robbers attacked him. They wanted to take the ring but couldn’t take it off. So, they cut off the finger and ran away. However, the man didn’t even scream. Why?
o_truth: He had gold teeth, and he didn’t want to show them, so that the robbers wouldn’t take them too.

zh_surface: 在公交车上，凯特想把座位让给一个刚上车的女人。但她非常尴尬，拒绝了。为什么？
zh_truth: 小凯特正坐在她爸爸的腿上。
o_surface: When on a bus, Kate wanted to offer her seat to a woman who's just goton. But she was very embarrassed and refused. Why?
o_truth: Little Kate was sitting in her dad's lap.

zh_surface:
当镇上一位著名的商人比尔把一桶蜂蜜推到广场上，请所有人品尝时，很多人都很惊讶。

但当人们问起这份礼物的缘由，听到比尔回答说这根本不是礼物时，他们更加惊讶了。
zh_truth: 比尔卖了很多年蜂蜜。他用量杯把蜂蜜舀起来，倒进买主的罐子里。但蜂蜜是一种黏稠的东西，要完全倒干净需要很长时间……从来没有顾客愿意等到最后一滴。可比尔是个少有的诚实人，他并不打算占有什么不属于自己的东西，哪怕只是几滴。他把剩下的蜂蜜倒进另一个罐子，年复一年，居然积满了一桶蜂蜜。现在，比尔最初那个奇怪的回答就清楚了：毕竟，人只能送出属于自己的东西，而他从不认为这些蜂蜜是自己的。他只是把这些蜂蜜还给了那些在某种意义上把它们留下长期存放的人。
o_surface:
Many people were surprised when a famous town merchant named Bill rolled out a barrel of honey to the square and offered everyone a treat. 

 But people were even more surprised when they asked about the reason for such a gift and heard Bill reply that it wasn’t a gift at all.
o_truth:
Bill has been selling honey for many years. He scooped the product up with a measuring cup and poured it into a buyer’s jug. 

 But honey is a thick substance, and it takes a long time to pour it out completely... None of the customers have ever waited until the last drop. 

 But Bill was a rarely honest man and wasn’t going to appropriate anything that wasn’t his, even if it was a matter of a few drops. He poured the rest of the honey into a separate jug, and over the years, he accumulated a barrel full of honey. Now, Bill’s initially strange answer is clear: after all, one can only give what’s one’s own, and he never thought that this honey was his own. He just RETURNED the honey to people who kind of left it for long-term storage.

zh_surface:
门铃响了。比尔打开门。在门口的台阶上，他看见一个本地流浪汉。

“你好，”流浪汉说，“跟平常一样，我翻垃圾桶的时候，在一个垃圾坑里找到一个钱包，里面有一千美元和你的身份证件。你一定是不小心把它扔掉了。”

“对！”比尔高兴地说，“我的钱包！太谢谢你了！”

“请你检查一下里面的东西。”流浪汉说。

“整整一千！”比尔匆匆数完钞票后确认道。然后他从一沓钱里抽出一张二十美元的钞票，递给流浪汉，“这是我的一点谢意！”

他们分手时，彼此都很满意。

“刚才是谁？”比尔的妻子问。

比尔笑着把发生的事告诉了妻子。

这事好笑在哪儿？
zh_truth:
流浪汉还钱包时，心里对酬谢抱着很高的期待。

但比尔手里也有可能根本没带零钱。

钱包里只有一百美元面额的钞票。

比尔会愿意付出那么大一笔钱吗？

于是流浪汉做了一个聪明的决定。在还钱包之前，他把一张一百换成了小面额——五美元、十美元、二十美元、五十美元，心想这样比尔就能自己挑选感谢他的金额了。

让比尔发笑的，正是流浪汉这份周全的考虑。
o_surface:
The doorbell rings. Bill opens the door. On the threshold, he sees a local vagrant. 

 

"Hello," says the vagrant, "as usual, I was going around the garbage pits and in one of them found a wallet with $1,000 and your ID. You must have thrown it away by mistake." 

 "Right!" says Bill joyfully. "My wallet! Thank you so much!" 

 "Please check the contents." the vagrant asks. 

 "One thousand even!" confirms Bill, counting the bills hastily. Then he takes a $20 bill out of the pack and gives it to the vagrant, "This is from me with thanks!" 

 

They part, being quite content with each other. 

 

"Who was it?" Bill’s wife asks.

 

Bill laughs and tells his wife what happened. 

 Why’s it funny?
o_truth:
When returning the wallet, the vagrant had high hopes for gratitude. 

But there was a chance that Bill wouldn’t have any broken money at hand. 

In the wallet, there were only $100 bills. 

Would Bill agree to pay such a large amount? 

 And the vagrant made a wise decision. Before returning the wallet, he had exchanged one hundred for smaller bills – 5, 10, 20, 50, deciding that thus Bill would be able to choose the amount to thank him with. 

 

 It was the vagrant’s forethought that made Bill laugh.

zh_surface: 一位教授去世后，他的遗嘱被严格照办了，但后来人们发现，他想要的其实完全是另一回事。为什么？
zh_truth: 教授把自己的骨架遗赠给了医学院。他死后，他的骨架被做成了一件教具。但后来，人们在教授的办公室里发现了一具立在架子上的骨架——教授心里想的，正是这具骨架。
o_surface: After a professor died, his will was followed carefully, but later it turned out that he wanted something completely different. Why?
o_truth: The professor signed his skeleton away to the medical university. After his death, his skeleton was turned into a teaching aid. But later a skeleton on a stand was found in the professor’s office – this very skeleton the professor had in mind.

zh_surface: 土著人住在大洋中间的一座岛上。可他们却找到了一条发财的路子。他们是怎么做到的？
zh_truth:
一场海难之后，海底留下了许多瓷花瓶。一百年来，最有经验的潜水员也拿不到它们。

土著人想出了一个巧妙的办法。他们抓来章鱼，把它拴住，然后潜下水去。

接着他们等着，直到章鱼在沉船残骸堆里的瓷碗瓷器中找到藏身之处。章鱼原来很固执——即使被绳子拽着，也不肯离开自己心爱的住处。

有时章鱼拽上来的是一块石头而不是瓷器，但总的来说还算顺利。
o_surface: Aborigines lived on an island in the middle of the ocean. However, they found a way to get rich. How did they do it?
o_truth:
There were porcelain vases left at the ocean bottom after a shipwreck. For 100 years, the most experienced divers couldn’t get them. 

 

The aborigines invented a clever method. They caught octopuses, tied them down, and plunged into the water. 

 

Then they waited until the animals find places to hide inside porcelain bowls and vessels among the pile of ship wreckage. Octopuses turned out to be stubborn – they didn’t want to part with their favorite dwelling, even when being pulled by the rope. 

 

Sometimes, the octopus pulled a stone instead of the porcelain, but it worked out all right. 

 

 From “Primates of the sea” by Igor Akimushkin

zh_surface: 四个大学生上课迟到了，他们向讲师解释说是因为车胎爆了。聪明的讲师很快向在场其他听众证明，这几个迟到者在撒谎。他是怎么做到的？
zh_truth: 讲师把四个迟到者分别带进不同的房间，问他们每个人：车子的哪个轮胎爆了。当然，他们给出了不同的答案。
o_surface: Four college students were late for a lecture and explained it to the lecturer by having a flat tire. The smart lecturer quickly proved to the rest of the audience that the latecomers had lied. How?
o_truth: The lecturer took all four latecomers to different rooms and asked each of them, on which of the car’s wheels the flat tire was. Of course, they gave different answers.

zh_surface: 他在森林里的时候，一头野兽咬掉了他的鼻子。可他三个月之后才死。
zh_truth: 那是个雪人。一只野兔咬掉了它的胡萝卜鼻子，而它到四月才融化。
o_surface: While he was in the forest, a wild beast bit off his nose. But he died only 3 months later.
o_truth: It was a snowman. A hare bit off its carrot nose, but it melted only in April.

zh_surface: 莎莉正在睡觉，被杰克叫醒了。她走到门口，发现一封信。她读完信就哭了起来。她现在知道，她的男朋友再也见不到她了。为什么？
zh_truth: 莎莉的男朋友不久前做了眼部手术。杰克是她男朋友的导盲犬，邮差送来一封信之后，它把莎莉叫醒了。信是医生寄来的，是对她男朋友医学检查的回复，检查结果确认手术失败，他今后将完全失明。
o_surface: Sally was sleeping when she was awoken by Jack. She walked to the door and found a letter. She read it and began to cry. She now knew that her boyfriend would never see her again. Why?
o_truth: Sally's boyfriend had recently undgone eye surgery. Jack, her boyfriend's guide-dog, awoke her after the postman had delivered a letter. The letter was from the doctor's. The letter was in response to her boyfriends medical tests that confirmed the surgery was unsuccesful and he would now be fully blind.

zh_surface: 卡米莉亚给瓦尔蒙端来一些葡萄酒。他看了一眼手表，喝了下去，然后死了。
zh_truth:
瓦尔蒙无可救药地爱着卡米莉亚，可她并不爱他。有一天，她向瓦尔蒙提出一个残酷的游戏：她在两杯酒中的一杯里下了毒，瓦尔蒙必须随便选一杯喝下去。如果他活下来，卡米莉亚就答应嫁给他。

瓦尔蒙把手表当成硬币来决定自己的命运（根据秒针在竖直线的左边还是右边来定）。他运气不好。
o_surface: Camellia brought Valmont some wine. He looked at his watch, drank and died.
o_truth:
Valmont was hopelessly in love with Camellia, but she didn’t reciprocate. One day she offered Valmont a cruel game: she put some poison into one of the two glasses of wine, and Valmont had to drink any of them. If he survived, Camelia agreed to marry him. 

 Valmont used his watch as a coin to decide his fate (by the position of the second hand to the left or right of the vertical line). He was unlucky.

zh_surface: 他并不饿，但食物救了他的命。
zh_truth: 他被绑在地牢里的一张长凳上。一把慢慢下落的镰刀在他上方摆动，本该要了他的命。然而，他用一碗食物剩下的残渣给身上的绳索上了油，绳子因此被老鼠咬断了。
o_surface: He wasn’t hungry, but food saved his life.
o_truth:
He was lying in a dungeon tied to a bench. A slowly descending sickle swung above him that was supposed to kill him. However, he used leftovers from a bowl of food to lubricate the ties (ropes), which were thus gnawed by rats. 

 From the story "The Pit and the Pendulum" by Edgar Poe.

zh_surface:
一位教授不肯收下一名学生的试卷。

学生：“你知道我是谁吗？”

教授：“我既不知道，也不在乎。别想吓唬我！”

但教授最后还是收下了试卷。为什么？
zh_truth:
那是一场笔试。除了一名学生，所有人都交了卷，可他在时间到了之后还在写。因此，教授拒绝收他的试卷。

当学生意识到教授并不知道他的名字时，他把自己的试卷塞进那一摞卷子的中间，然后跑掉了。
o_surface:
A professor didn’t want to accept a student’s paper. 

Student: “Do you know who I am?”

Professor: “I neither know nor care. And don’t try to frighten me!”

But the professor still accepted the paper. Why?
o_truth:
A written exam. All but one student submitted the papers, but he kept writing after the time was up. Therefore, the professor refused to accept his paper. 

 When the student realized that the professor didn’t know his name, he put his paper in the middle of the stack and ran away.

zh_surface: 有一天，马克把自己的手表藏了起来。为了什么？
zh_truth:
——我们结婚三十一年了。

——你们是怎么认识的？

——我在公交车上看见她，就摘下手表，放进衣兜里。然后我坐到她旁边，问她现在几点了。
o_surface: One day Mark hid his watch. What for?
o_truth:
– We have been married for thirty-one years.

– How did you meet?

– I saw her on the bus, took off my watch, and put it in my pocket. Then, he sat down next to her and asked what time it was.

zh_surface: 每天晚上睡觉前，丽莎都会锁好家门，然后把钥匙系在一根绳子上。为什么？
zh_truth: 丽莎有梦游的毛病。几天前，她半夜里不知不觉地出了家门。为了防止这种事再发生，她开始每天晚上用一根绳子把钥匙系在一个铃铛上。这样一来，如果丽莎想要出门，她的丈夫就会醒来，把她带回床上。
